blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Romanized Nepali, Nepali written in Latin script, is common in digital communication but has no standard spelling and few resources, and it is unclear how reliably small open language models can be adapted to it. We adapt three 2-3B base models from different families, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Gemma-2-2B, with QLoRA on 9,000 instruction examples produced by deterministic transliteration of Nepali instruction data. Each model is trained with one shared recipe and three seeds and evaluated on 1,000 held-out examples with reference-overlap metrics, byte-normalized reference likelihood (bits per byte, BPB), and an output audit, against zero-shot baselines under two prompts. Fine-tuning raises chrF++ from 10-14 to 29.0-30.6 and lowers BPB from 2.23-2.41 to 0.78-0.84; most zero-shot outputs (54-92%) are English-like. Likelihood and overlap disagree on how far apart the models are. Llama-3.2-3B has the lowest BPB in every seed, 0.042 below Qwen2.5-3B (95% CI 0.039-0.046), yet the two cannot be separated on chrF++ (30.51 and 30.61) or BLEU, even with paired item-level tests. Gemma-2-2B, whose tokenizer splits Romanized Nepali words least (2.72 tokens per word), scores worst on every measure. Which model gains most over its zero-shot baseline depends on the zero-shot prompt. In a supplementary comparison with an identical tokenizer, Llama-3.1-8B lowers BPB by 0.053 (0.050-0.056) relative to Llama-3.2-3B, while chrF++ and BLEU rise by only 0.68 and 0.58 points. Lower fertility and higher reference likelihood therefore did not identify the model whose outputs were closest to the references.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Nepali is written in Devanagari, yet much of its everyday digital use is in Latin script. More than half of the comments in a Nepali social-media corpus were transliterated or mixed [ 31 ] , and users of a Nepali sexual and reproductive health chatbot wrote 61.0% of their queries in Romanized Nepali, against 23.2% in Devanagari and 15.8% in English [ 46 , Fig. 4A] . Romanized Nepali has no standard orthography: the same word can be spelled in several ways, and English words are often mixed in [ 5 ] . Language models also handle romanized input less well than the native script. In a real-world triage setting, one strong model’s F1 on Romanized Nepali messages was 9.5 points below its F1 on Devanagari messages [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh: 尼泊尔语用德瓦纳加里语写成,然而其日常数字化使用多为拉丁字母. 尼泊尔社会媒体的一半以上的评论被转写或混合[31],尼泊尔性健康和生殖健康聊天机器人的用户用罗马化的尼泊尔语撰写了61.0%的询问,而德瓦纳加里语为23.2%,英语为15.8%[46, Fig. 4A]. 罗马化的尼泊尔语没有标准的正字法:同一词可以用几种方式拼写,英语词往往混合在[5]中. 语言模型也处理罗马化输入比本土脚本要少. 在现实世界中,一个强大的模式F1关于罗马化的尼泊尔语信息比Devanagari的F1低9.5点。

blocks.en: There are two broad responses. One converts the input: spelling normalization improved sentiment classification of Romanized Nepali reviews [ 5 ] , and transliterating comments back to Devanagari helped multilingual classifiers [ 33 ] . The other adapts a model to read and write Romanized Nepali directly, which suits generation, where the output itself must be in the script that users type. Small open models of 2–3B parameters make this route practical, because parameter-efficient methods let them be adapted on a single 16 GB GPU [ 6 ] , as in this study.
blocks.zh: 有两个广泛的对策。 一个将输入转换为:拼写正常化改善对罗马化尼泊尔评论的情感分类[5],并将评论转写回Devanagari帮助多语种分类者[33]. 另一种则对一个模型进行修改,直接读写罗马化的尼泊尔语,这适合生成,输出本身必须是在用户输入的脚本中. 2–3B参数的小型开放模型使得这条路由变得实用,因为参数效率高的方法允许它们在单一的16GB GPU[6]上进行改编,如本研究.

blocks.en: Choosing and evaluating such models is not straightforward. Candidate models differ at once in tokenizer, architecture, size and pretraining data. Tokenizer fertility, the number of subword tokens per word, is an appealing selection criterion, because text that is rare in a tokenizer’s training data is split into many pieces [ 42 , 34 ] , but its relation to downstream performance is inconsistent across studies [ 1 , 13 , 43 ] . Per-token perplexity cannot be compared across models with different tokenizers [ 11 ] . A model’s likelihood on reference text need not reflect the properties of the text it generates [ 28 ] , and single training runs hide how much results vary with the random seed [ 8 ] . The closest prior benchmark for Romanized Nepali compared three 7–8B models with one run each and per-token perplexity [ 41 ] , leaving open how small models compare and which measures can be trusted to rank them.
blocks.zh: 选择和评价这种模式并非直截了当。 候选模型在标致器,架构,大小和预训数据上一时不同. Tokenizer生育率,每个字的子词符数,是一个吸引人的选择标准,因为一个标语器的训练数据中罕见的文本被分成许多块[42,34],但是它与下游表现的关系在不同的研究中是不一致的[1,13,43]. Per-token 迷惑性不能用不同的标致器在模型中进行比较 [11]. 一个模型在参考文本上的可能性不需要反映它生成的文本的属性[28],单项训练会隐藏结果与随机种子的不同程度[8]. 对罗马化尼泊尔语而言,最接近的先前基准比较了三个7-8B模型,每个模型有一个运行,每个模型的复杂度[41],留下了小模型如何比较以及可以信任哪些措施来排列它们。

blocks.en: We study the adaptation of three 2–3B base models from different families, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B and Gemma-2-2B, to a Romanized Nepali instruction task. The task is controlled: Romanized text was produced from Devanagari instruction data by deterministic, lowercased ITRANS transliteration, so every word has one spelling (Section 3 ). All models share one QLoRA recipe, a validation split for checkpoint selection and three training seeds. We measure tokenizer fertility, byte-normalized reference likelihood (bits per byte, BPB) and reference-overlap metrics, audit the generated outputs, and compare against zero-shot baselines under two prompt formats. A supplementary comparison with Llama-3.1-8B, whose tokenizer encodes our references identically to that of Llama-3.2-3B, adds a within-family contrast. We ask four questions:
blocks.zh: 我们研究将来自不同家庭的3个2-3B基模,Llama-3.2-3B,Quen2.5-3B和Gemma-2-2B, 改编成罗马化的尼泊尔教学任务。 任务由控制: 罗马化的文本是通过定型的Devanagari指令数据生成的,小写为ITRANS转写,所以每个词都有一个拼写(第3节. 所有型号都共享一个QLORA配方,用于检查点选择的验证分成和三个训练种子. 我们测量标注器的生育力、字节正常的参考概率(每字节比特、BPB)和参考重叠度量,审计产生的产出,并在两种快速格式下与零射线基线进行比较。 与Llama-3.1-8B的补充比较,后者的标语编码了我们与Llama-3.2-3B的参照,增加了家庭内部的对比。 我们提出四个问题:

blocks.en: • RQ1. How do three 2–3B base-model families adapt to Romanized Nepali under one parameter-efficient recipe, and how stable are the outcomes across training seeds? • RQ2. Does tokenizer fertility on Romanized Nepali indicate which model adapts best? • RQ3. Do reference likelihood and generation overlap agree on how models compare, after adaptation and within one model family when tokenization is identical? • RQ4. blocks.en: The paper makes four contributions:
blocks.zh: 文件提出了四项意见:

blocks.en: (1) A multi-seed evaluation of three 2–3B base-model families adapted to Romanized Nepali under one QLoRA recipe, reporting both training-seed and test-item uncertainty. (2) Evidence that byte-normalized reference likelihood and generation overlap give different pictures of adapted models, including in a tokenizer-identical within-family comparison. (3) A fertility analysis of four tokenizers on the benchmark references and, under three romanization conventions, on public Nepali text, in which the least-fragmenting tokenizer belonged to the lowest-scoring model and the order of tokenizers was the same under every convention. (4) An analysis of zero-shot behaviour showing that the base models mostly answer in English and that the order of models by gain over zero-shot changes with the prompt.

Section 2 reviews related work, Sections 3 and 4 describe the data and experimental setup, Section 5 reports the results, and Sections 6 – 8 discuss them.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Romanized Nepali
blocks.zh: 2.1 罗马化尼泊尔语

blocks.en: Nepali is written in Devanagari, an abugida in which a consonant letter carries an inherent vowel unless it is marked otherwise. The script distinguishes some sounds that spoken Nepali does not: it has long and short i and u , but spoken Nepali has no vowel-length contrast [ 22 ] . Other distinctions are contrastive in speech, such as aspiration and the contrast between dental and retroflex stops [ 22 ] . Writers of Romanized Nepali have no agreed way of marking these distinctions in Latin script, so spellings vary across writers [ 5 ] . Nepali NLP in Devanagari includes sequence-labelling tools [ 39 ] , tokenizer comparisons for language models [ 27 ] and continual pretraining of an 8B model on Nepali [ 10 ] . Work on Romanized Nepali has mostly addressed classification: offensive-language detection in social media, where transliterated text was common [ 31 ] ; sentiment analysis after spelling normalization [ 5 ] ; and sentiment analysis after transliteration back to Devanagari with NepaliXlit [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh: 尼泊尔语用Devanagari书写,这是一个bugida语,其中相容字母带有固有元音,除非另有标记。 剧本区分了一些说尼泊尔语没有的音:它有长而短的i和u,但说尼泊尔语没有元音长的对比[22]. 其他区别在言语上是反差的,如欲望和牙科与反射停止的反差[22]. 罗马化尼泊尔语的作家们没有商定的在拉丁文中标注这些区别的方法,因此各作家的拼写方法各不相同[5]. Devanagari的NLP包括序列标签工具[39],语言模型的标语比较[27],以及尼泊尔语8B模型的持续预训[10]。 有关罗马化的尼泊尔语的工作大多涉及分类:社交媒体的进攻性语言检测,其中转写文本常见[31];拼写正常化后的情绪分析[5];转写回Devanagari与NepaliXlit [33].

blocks.en: 2.2 Romanized and Transliterated Text in Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 语文模型中的罗马化和翻译文本

blocks.en: Romanized text in South Asian languages is common online, and language models handle it unevenly. In real-world triage messages in six Indian languages including Nepali, F1 on romanized text was 5–12 points lower than on native script [ 23 ] . For Sinhala, a benchmark of language models found far higher perplexity on romanized than on native-script text, measured per token across different tokenizers [ 40 ] . Romanization can also be used deliberately: RomanSetu uses romanized text as an interface to English-centric models, reducing token fertility by a factor of 2–4 relative to native scripts and matching native-script performance on a range of tasks [ 17 ] . In this journal, Baruah et al. [ 3 ] characterized how Romanized Assamese is written in social media and built machine transliteration for it. These studies concern natural romanized text or romanization as a tool. The adaptation of small generative models to produce romanized text, and how such adaptation should be evaluated, has received less attention.
blocks.zh: 南亚语言的罗马化文本在网上很常见,语言模型处理不均匀. 在真实世界用包括尼泊尔语在内的6种印度语言进行分类的信息中,罗马化文本上的F1比本土文字上的F1低5–12分[23]. 对于僧伽罗语,一个语言模型的基准发现,罗马化文字比本地标语文字的复杂程度要高得多,在不同的标语符号上按每个标语衡量[40]. 罗曼化也可以被刻意使用:罗曼塞图使用罗马化文本作为以英语为中心的模型的接口,相对于本土脚本将象征性的生育力减少2–4倍,并在一系列任务上匹配本土标注的性能[17]. 在这份期刊中,Baruah et al. [3] 描述罗马化的阿萨姆塞语是如何在社交媒体上写作,并为它建立了机器转写. 这些研究涉及自然罗马化文本或罗马化作为一种工具. 小型基因模型的适应性以产生罗马化文本,以及如何评价这种适应性,受到的关注较少。

blocks.en: 2.3 Tokenization and Model Performance
blocks.zh: 2.3 数据化和模型性能

blocks.en: Subword tokenizers built with byte-pair encoding or SentencePiece [ 44 , 25 ] split text that is rare in their training data into more pieces. Fertility, the average number of tokens per word, is the usual measure of this [ 42 ] . Tokenized length differs by up to 15 times across languages for the same content [ 34 ] , and for encoder models a dedicated monolingual tokenizer can matter about as much as the amount of pretraining data [ 42 ] . Whether fertility predicts downstream performance is less clear. In controlled pretraining, fertility and parity were not always predictive of downstream results [ 1 ] ; text compression tracked performance, especially for generation tasks and smaller models [ 13 ] ; and a tokenizer that minimized token count did not yield better models [ 43 ] . For Turkish, a study in this journal found a morphological tokenizer competitive with, but not consistently better than, statistical tokenizers [ 48 ] , and for Devanagari Nepali, SentencePiece tokenizers performed better than byte-level BPE on understanding tasks [ 27 ] . In language transfer, extending a model’s vocabulary to shorten target-language text was not beneficial at training scales of tens of billions of tokens [ 50 ] . These studies vary the tokenizer under controlled pretraining or transfer. Our question is narrower: whether the fertility of existing tokenizers helps choose among pretrained models to adapt.
blocks.zh: 用字节-pair编码或句子Piece [44, 25] 构建的子词符号化器将训练数据中罕见的文本分割成更多块. 生育率,每个字的平均符数,是这个[42]的通常衡量标准. 不同语言的编码长度不同,最高可达15倍,内容相同[34],对于编码器模型,专用的单一语言代词器可以和预训数据的数量一样重要[42]. 生育率是否预测下游的表现不太清楚。 在有控制的预训中,生育力和均价并不总是能预测下游结果[1];文本压缩跟踪性能,尤其是对于生成任务和较小的模型[13];以及一种最小化符号计数的标点剂并不能产生更好的模型[43]. 对于土耳其人来说,该期刊上的一项研究发现一种形态示意剂与统计示意剂竞争,但并非一贯好于统计示意剂[48],对于Devanagari Nepali来说,PrimentPiece示意剂在理解任务上的表现优于字节级BPE[27]. 在语言转移方面,扩展模型的词汇以缩短目标语言文本对于数百亿令牌的培训规模是没有好处的。 这些研究使受控预训或转移下的标语符不同. 我们的问题更窄:现有标本器的生育率是否有助于在经过预先训练的模型中作出适应选择。

blocks.en: 2.4 Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Low-Resource Languages
blocks.zh: 2.4 低资源语言参数有效适应

blocks.en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) trains small low-rank updates to frozen weights [ 16 ] . QLoRA applies it to a 4-bit quantized base model, which reduces memory enough to fine-tune large models on a single GPU [ 6 ] , and rank-stabilized LoRA (rsLoRA) scales the update by α \alpha / √ \surd r rather than α \alpha / r , which prevents learning from slowing at higher ranks [ 20 ] . These methods are widely used to adapt open models to low-resource languages. LoRA fine-tuning of Gemma on a translated Alpaca dataset for Marathi lowered automatic scores while manual judgments favoured the tuned model [ 21 ] ; parameter-efficient fine-tuning of 3–7B models for Bengali hate-speech classification found Llama-3.2-3B best [ 19 ] ; continual pretraining with 4-bit QLoRA taught Llama 3 8B to generate Nepali, with some forgetting [ 10 ] ; and in this journal, Tibetan-LLaMA 2 adapted an open model to Tibetan [ 45 ] . All of these concern native-script text.
blocks.zh: 低等级适应(LORA)列车小低等级更新至冷冻重量[16]. QLORA将其应用到4位的量子化基模型上,它能减少内存,足以在单一的GPU[6]上对大型模型进行微调,而级别稳定的LORA(rs-stableized LORA)通过α\alpha / \\ surd r 而不是α\alpha / r 进行更新,从而防止学习在更高级别上放缓 [20]. 这些方法被广泛用于适应低资源语言的开放模型. LoRA在马拉地翻译的阿尔帕卡数据集上微调Gemma,降低了自动分数,而人工判断则倾向于调制模型[21];对孟加拉语仇恨语分类的3–7B模型的参数效率微调发现Llama-3.2-3B最好[19];持续预训4位QLORA教Llama 3-8B生成Nepali,有的忘记了[10];在这份期刊中,藏语-LLLRAMA 2对藏语的开放模型进行了调整[45]. 所有这些都涉及当地文字。

blocks.en: 2.5 Evaluating Adapted Models
blocks.zh: 2.5 评价适应模式

blocks.en: Generated text is usually compared with references using BLEU [ 32 ] , chrF and chrF++ [ 35 , 36 ] , ROUGE [ 26 ] or embedding similarity such as BERTScore [ 49 ] . Character-level chrF credits partial matches within words, which suits morphologically rich languages [ 35 ] , but all of these metrics reward closeness to one reference. Likelihood-based measures instead evaluate a model on the reference itself. Per-token perplexity depends on the tokenizer, whereas bits per byte normalizes the total negative log-likelihood by the length of the text in bytes, which makes it comparable across tokenizers [ 11 ] . The two kinds of measure can diverge: a model that assigns high probability to human text may still generate text with different statistical properties [ 28 ] . Comparisons also need explicit uncertainty. Fine-tuning results vary substantially with the random seed [ 8 ] ; differences between systems evaluated on one test set should be assessed with resampling or significance tests [ 24 , 9 ] ; and metric configurations should be reported so that scores can be reproduced [ 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 生成的文本通常与使用BLEU [32],chrF和chrF++ [35,36],ROUGE [26] 或嵌入相似性如BERTScore [49]的引用相比较. 字符级的chrF在单词中记分部分匹配,这符合形态丰富的语言[35],但所有这些度量都奖励了一种引用的亲近性. 相反,基于可能性的衡量标准是根据参考本身评估一个模型。 每字节的偏差取决于标注符,而每字节的比特则通过以字节表示的文本长度来使总负对数的比特态正常化,这使得它在标注符上具有可比性[11]. 两种计量方法可能存在差异:一种给人类文本分配高概率的模型仍然可能产生具有不同统计属性的文本[28]. 比较还需要明确的不确定性。 微调结果因随机种子[8]而大不相同;在一个测试集上评价的系统之间的差异应评估为重印或意义测试[24,9];应报告度量配置,以便分数可以复制[37]。

blocks.en: 2.6 The Closest Benchmark
blocks.zh: 2.6 最终基准

blocks.en: Rimal and Rimal [ 41 ] fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1 and Qwen3-8B on 10,000 Romanized Nepali instruction examples built from the source dataset used here, with half of the instructions machine-translated into English and half transliterated. They trained one QLoRA model with rsLoRA per architecture and reported perplexity, BERTScore, chrF++, ROUGE and BLEU, together with a qualitative case study. All three models adapted, and Qwen3-8B obtained the highest fine-tuned chrF++ (27.47, against 26.97 for Llama-3.1-8B and 23.95 for Mistral-7B-v0.1). They defined adaptation headroom as the fine-tuned minus the zero-shot value of a metric, argued that models with weaker zero-shot performance have more “representational plasticity”, and attributed Llama’s difficulty to “its Tiktoken tokenizer over-fragmenting Romanized Nepali into low-frequency subword units”, leaving the measurement of fertility to future work. Their study leaves open how smaller models compare, how much results vary across training runs, whether directly measured fertility supports the over-fragmentation account, and how likelihood compares across models with different tokenizers. We are not aware of a study that measures tokenizer fertility, byte-normalized reference likelihood and generation overlap together for small models adapted to Romanized Nepali, with seed-level uncertainty. Our recipe follows theirs (Section 4.2 ), but model scale, data processing, checkpoint selection, decoding and the likelihood measure differ, so we compare findings, not scores.
blocks.zh: 里马尔和里马尔[41]微调了Llama-3.1-8B,Mistral-7B-v0.1和Qwen3-8B对从这里使用的源数据集中构建的10,000个罗马化尼泊尔语指令实例,其中一半的指令用机器翻译为英语,一半被转写. 他们用每个架构的rsLORA模型培训了一个QLORA模型,并报告了复杂度、BERTScore、chrF++、ROUGE和BLEU,以及定性案例研究。 所有三种型号都经过改造,Qune3-8B获得了最高的微调chrF++(27.47,Llama-31-8B为26.97,Mistral-7B-v0.1为23.95). 他们将适应头室定义为微调减去一个度量的零射值,认为零射效率较弱的模型具有更多的 " 代表性可塑性 " ,并将Llama的难度归因于 " 其Tiktoken活化的罗曼化尼泊尔语过度分化为低频子词单位 " ,将生育力的衡量留给未来工作。 他们的研究使人们可以了解模型比较的较小程度、培训结果的不同程度、直接衡量的生育率是否支持过度分解账户,以及模型与不同标注器之间的概率如何比较。 我们不知道,对于适合罗马化尼泊尔语的小型模型,有种级的不确定性,我们没有进行一项研究,衡量标定剂的生育力、字节正常化的参考概率和生成率。 我们的食谱遵循他们的食谱(第4.2节),但模型尺度,数据处理,检查点选择,解码和概率度量不同,所以我们比较调查结果,而不是分数.

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: 3.1 Source, Filtering and Splits
blocks.zh: 3.1 源、过滤和分割

blocks.en: The source is the Nepali instruction dataset Saugatkafley/alpaca-nepali-sft on the Hugging Face Hub, with 52,005 examples whose instruction, input and output fields are in Devanagari. Its dataset card states no licence and gives little information on provenance, but the data are a Nepali translation of the Stanford Alpaca data [ 47 ] , which is released under CC BY-NC 4.0. The type A instructions of our test split (Section 3.3 ), translated back into English, match Alpaca instructions closely: 29.8% are identical to one of its 52,002 instructions, and 92.2% have a normalized edit similarity of at least 0.8 to the nearest one. We follow the data recipe of Rimal and Rimal [ 41 ] with our own transliteration choices. We removed examples that still contained Devanagari characters after transliteration and examples whose outputs were shorter than three words, which left 48,106 eligible examples; examples with an empty input field were kept. From these we drew 10,500 examples (sampling seed 42) and split them into 9,000 training, 500 validation and 1,000 test examples, with the two instruction types (Section 3.3 ) balanced 50/50 in every split. The 500-example validation split, which the prior recipe does not describe, accounts for the difference from its 10,000 examples.
blocks.zh: 来源于Hugging Face Hub上的尼泊尔指令数据集Saugatkafley/alpaca-nepali-sft,有52 005个实例,其指令、输入和输出字段位于Devanagari。 其数据集卡上写着没有许可证,也很少给出出处信息,但数据是斯坦福阿尔帕卡(Stanford Alpaca)数据的尼泊尔语译名[47],该数据在CC BY-NC 4.0下发布. 我们测试分拆的A型指令(第3.3节),又译为英语,与阿尔帕卡指令紧密匹配: 29.8%与其52 002个指令之一完全相同,92.2%的规范编辑相似度至少为0.8。 我们遵循里马尔和里马尔的数据配方 用我们自己的转写选择。 我们删除了在转写后仍然包含Devanagari字符的例子,以及产出短于三个字的例子,这些例子留下了48 106个合格例子;保留了带有空输入字段的例子。 我们从这些例子中抽取了10 500个例子(样本种子42),分成9 000个培训、500个鉴定和1 000个测试例子,两种指导类型(第3.3节)在每分中平衡50/50。 先前的食谱没有描述的500例验证拆分,说明与它的1万例的区别.

blocks.en: Empty inputs occur in 5,576 training, 314 validation and 660 test examples. Split files are identified by SHA-256 prefixes (train 9ed86da7…, validation 3f7f6854…, test d656353e…; full hashes in the code repository). We found no exact instruction overlap between splits. One output is shared between the training and validation splits and three between the training and test splits, each of three or more words, and we kept them. We also kept two artifacts of the source data: placeholder strings meaning “no input” in 114 training, 5 validation and 14 test examples, and zero-width-space characters in 113, 11 and 12 examples.
blocks.zh: 空投入出现在5,576个培训,314个验证和660个测试实例中. 拆分文件由SHA-256前缀识别(列车9ed86da7...,校验3f7f6854...,测试d656353e.;代码存储器中的全散列). 我们发现没有精确的指令 重叠的分裂。 一项产出由训练与鉴定分开来分享,三项由训练与试验分开来分享,每个三个或三个以上的字,我们保留下来. 我们还保留了两个来源数据文物:114个培训中表示“不输入”的占位字符串、5个验证和14个测试实例以及113、11和12个实例中的零宽空格字符。

blocks.en: 3.2 Romanization
blocks.zh: 3.2 罗马化

blocks.en: Romanized text was produced by ITRANS transliteration of the Devanagari fields, followed by lowercasing. Rimal and Rimal [ 41 ] describe their transliteration as using an Indic transliteration library with phonetic variation permitted, so the scheme is our choice. Table 1 shows how it treats some common words. It has three properties that matter for interpreting the results.
blocks.zh: 罗马化文本由德瓦纳加里字段的ITRANS转写而成,之后是下加码. Rimal和Rimal[41]描述他们的转写是使用一个带有允许的语音变体的Indic转写库,所以这个方案是我们的选择. 表1显示了它如何对待一些常见的单词. 它有三个特性,对解释结果很重要。

blocks.en: First, it is deterministic: every Devanagari word has exactly one romanized spelling, so the benchmark contains none of the spelling variation of naturally typed Romanized Nepali.
blocks.zh: 首先,它是决定性的:每个Devanagari词都有完全一个罗马化的拼法,因此基准没有包含自然输入的罗马化尼泊尔语的拼法变体.

blocks.en: Second, lowercasing removes the case distinctions that ITRANS uses to encode Devanagari letters, which merges 11 groups of letters: eight consonant groups ( / , / , / , / , / , / , / and / ) and three vowel groups ( / , / and / , with their vowel signs; Appendix B ). Some merged pairs are contrastive in spoken Nepali, such as unaspirated and aspirated affricates ( / ) and dental and retroflex stops ( / , / ), whereas the long and short vowels are distinguished only in the script [ 22 ] . To estimate how much text the merger affects, we transliterated a public sample of 1,233 Nepali sentences (Section 5.1 and Appendix B ). In this sample, 58.8% of running words contain at least one uppercase ITRANS character, so lowercasing changes the spelling of most words, and 3.8% of the resulting word types merge two or more distinct ITRANS spellings. These merged types are frequent: they cover 13.8% of running words, as with and (both pani ) or , and (all tina ).
blocks.zh: 其次,下调删除了ITRANS用于编码Devanagari字母的大小写区分,该大小写将11组字母合并:8组对应字母(/,/,/,/,/,/,/和/)和3个元音组(/,/,和/,与它们的元音符号;附录B). 一些合并的对子在口语尼泊尔语中具有对比性,如无呼吸和呼吸的支离子(/)和牙科和逆力停止(/,/),而长和短的元音只在脚本中区分[22]. 为了估计合并对案文的影响,我们转录了1 233个尼泊尔语句子的公开样本(第5.1节和附录B)。 在这个样本中,58.8%的运行中的单词至少包含一个大写ITRANS字符,因此低调会改变大多数单词的拼写方式,3.8%产生的单词类型将两个或两个以上独立的ITRANS拼写方式合并. 这些合并类型很常见:它们覆盖了13.8%的运行中的单词,如与(pani)或(Pani)和(All tina)一样。

blocks.en: Third, the scheme keeps the inherent vowel at the end of a word, which conventional romanizations often drop: is conventionally written Nepal , but the scheme gives nepala . In the public sample, 36.2% of running words end in an inherent vowel, and 29.4% are words of two or more aksharas (orthographic syllables) that do so. For the fertility analysis we therefore also use two alternative conventions: case-preserving ITRANS (R1) and the benchmark scheme without the final inherent vowel in words of two or more aksharas (R3), a simple approximation of informal spelling. The benchmark scheme itself is R2.
blocks.zh: 第三,该计划将固有元音保留在一个单词的结尾,常规罗马化经常下降:是传统书写的尼泊尔语,但该计划赋予了nepala. 在公众抽样中,36.2%的运行中的单词以固有元音结尾,29.4%是两个或两个以上akshara的单词(正字音节)来完成. 因此,在生育率分析方面,我们还采用两种备选惯例:保留案例的ITRANS(R1)和没有两个或两个以上akshara(R3)词中最后固有元音的基准方案,非正式拼写法的简单近似。 基准计划本身为R2.

blocks.en: Table 1: Example words under the three romanization conventions. R2 (lowercased ITRANS) is the benchmark scheme; R1 and R3 are used only in the fertility analysis (Section 5.1 ). Under R2, and , and , and and become identical.
blocks.zh: 表1:三项罗马化公约下的例子词。 R2(较低水平的ITRANS)是基准方案;R1和R3只在生育率分析中使用(第5.1节)。 在R2下,和,和,并变得一模一样。

blocks.en: 3.3 Instruction Formats
blocks.zh: 3.3 指令格式

blocks.en: Following the prior recipe [ 41 ] , each example has one of two formats. In type A, the instruction was machine-translated from Nepali into English and the input and output were transliterated; in type B, all three fields were transliterated. Type A instructions have therefore been translated twice, from English into Nepali in the source dataset and back into English here, and back-translation sometimes changes the meaning: one test instruction asks why chloroplasts are found “in plant cells and animal cells”, where the Alpaca original has “in plant cells and not animal cells”. Prompts follow the Alpaca template [ 47 ] , with its no-input variant for examples without an input, and the target is always the Romanized Nepali output.
blocks.zh: 遵循之前的配方[41],每个例子都有两种格式之一. 在A型中,该指令由尼泊尔语机译为英语,输入和输出音译;在B型中,三个字段全部音译. 类型 因此,一项指令被两次翻译,从源数据集中的英语翻译成尼泊尔语,再译回这里的英语,反翻译有时会改变其含义:一项测试指令问为什么在“植物细胞和动物细胞”中发现了氯氧化物,Alpaca的原生细胞有“植物细胞而不是动物细胞”。 提示跟随阿尔帕卡模板[47],其无输入的变体用于没有输入的例子,目标总是罗马化的尼泊尔产出.

blocks.en: 3.4 Length
blocks.zh: 3.4 长度

blocks.en: Training sequences (prompt plus response) were limited to 512 tokens, which truncated 178 (Qwen2.5-3B), 164 (Llama-3.2-3B) and 127 (Gemma-2-2B) of the 9,000 training examples (1.4–2.0%) and 6, 6 and 5 of the 500 validation examples. In the test set, 19, 17 and 14 examples exceed 512 tokens under the same tokenizers, but no generation prompt does (Section 4.5 ). The 1,000 test references contain 41,388 whitespace-delimited words, 41.4 per response on average, and 124 (Qwen2.5-3B), 117 (Llama-3.2-3B) and 88 (Gemma-2-2B) of them are longer than the 256-token generation limit.
blocks.zh: 培训序列(即时加响应)限于512个令牌,在9 000个培训实例(1.4-2.0%)和500个验证实例中的178个(Quen2.5-3B)、164个(Llama-3.2-3B)和127个(Gemma-2-2B)以及6个和5个。 在测试集中,19,17和14个例子在同样的标语符下超过512个令牌,但是没有一代的提示(第4.5节). 1000个测试参考文献中包含41,388个白空限字,平均每个响应41.4个,其中124个(Quen2.5-3B),117个(Llama-32-3B)和88个(Gemma-2-2B)比256个托肯生成限长.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: All models are base checkpoints that were not instruction-tuned: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B [ 30 ] , Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B [ 38 ] and google/gemma-2-2b [ 12 ] in the main comparison, and meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B [ 14 , 29 ] in the supplementary within-family comparison (Table 2 ; revisions in Appendix A ). The three primary models differ in more than the tokenizer. Gemma-2-2B has about 2.0 billion non-embedding parameters against 2.8 billion for the other two, saw fewer pretraining tokens, and puts 22.6% of its parameters into the embeddings of its 256k-entry vocabulary. Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-2-2B were trained with knowledge distillation from larger models [ 30 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 所有型号均为基点检查站,未经指导调整:元拉玛/Llama-3.2-3B[30],文/Quen2.5-3B[38]和Google/gemma-2-2b[12]在主比较中,元拉玛/Llama-3.1-8B[14,29]在补充家庭内部比较中(表2;附录A中的修订)。 三种主要的模型在比标致器上的差异更大. Gemma-2-2B有大约20亿的非嵌入参数,而其他两种是28亿,预训符较少,并将22.6%的参数放入其256k-enter词汇的嵌入. Llama-3.2-3B和Gemma-2-2B接受了大型模型的知识蒸馏培训[30,12].

blocks.en: Table 2: Models. Parameter counts are computed from the published model configurations; the embedding share of Llama-3.1-8B includes its separate output matrix. Vocabulary, pretraining tokens and licences are from the model reports and cards [ 12 , 14 , 29 , 30 , 38 ] . The LoRA adapter sizes implied by these configurations match the trainable-parameter counts in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 表2:模型。 参数计数从已公布的模型配置中计算;Llama-3.1-8B的嵌入份额包括其单独的输出矩阵. 词汇、预训信条和许可证来自示范报告和卡[12、14、29、30、38]。 这些配置所暗示的LORA适配器尺寸与4.2节中的可列车参数计数相符。

blocks.en: 4.2 Adaptation Recipe
blocks.zh: 4.2 适应食谱

blocks.en: Each model is adapted with QLoRA [ 6 ] through Unsloth [ 15 ] . Base weights are loaded in 4-bit NF4 with double quantization and fp16 compute, and rank-stabilized LoRA adapters [ 20 ] ( r = 32, α \alpha = 64, dropout 0, no bias) are trained on the attention ( q_proj , k_proj , v_proj , o_proj ) and feed-forward ( gate_proj , up_proj , down_proj ) projections. With rank-stabilized scaling the adapter output is multiplied by α \alpha / √ \surd r = 64/ √ \surd 32 ≈ \approx 11.3, which is 5.7 times the standard LoRA factor α \alpha / r = 2 [ 16 ] . The adapters have 59.9M trainable parameters for Qwen2.5-3B, 48.6M for Llama-3.2-3B, 41.5M for Gemma-2-2B and 83.9M for Llama-3.1-8B (1.0–1.9% of the total). Unsloth substitutes its own pre-quantized 4-bit checkpoints where they exist (the Llama-3.2-3B zero-shot log shows unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-unsloth-bnb-4bit ) and leaves some modules unquantized, depending on the model: lm_head and the MLPs of layers 1, 2, 3, 28 and 30 for Qwen2.5-3B, lm_head and the layer-1 MLP for Llama-3.2-3B, and none for Gemma-2-2B (measured with Unsloth 2026.11.2; runs under other versions may differ).
blocks.zh: 每个型号都与QLORA[6]通过Unsloth[15]进行改造. 基重以4位NF4加载,双量子化和fp16计算,排名稳定的LORA适配器[20](r = 32,α\ alpha = 64,淘汰0,没有偏差)在注意(q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj)和进料(gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj)预测上进行训练. 以等级稳定缩放的适配器输出乘以 α\ alpha / √\ surd r = 64/ √\ surd 32 ≈\\ 约 11.3,是标准洛拉系数 α\ alpha / r = 2 [16] 的5.7倍. 适配器有Quen2.5-3B的59.9M可列车参数,Llama-3.2-3B的48.6M,Gemma-2-2B的41.5M和Llama-31-8B的83.9M(占总数的1.0-1.9%). (Llama-3.2-3B零射线日志显示Usloth/Llama-3.2-3B-unsloth-bnb-4bit) 并留下一些模块未量化,视模型而定:lm_head和1,2,3,28和30层的MLP对Quen2.5-3B,lm_head和1层MLP对Llama-3.2-3B,没有Gemma-2-2B(用Unsloth 2026.11.2测量;在其他版本下运行可能有所不同).

blocks.en: Training uses a learning rate of 1 × \times 10 − - 4 with cosine decay and 200 warm-up steps, 8-bit AdamW, three epochs (3,375 optimizer steps), a maximum sequence length of 512 tokens without packing, fp16, and an effective batch size of 8 (2 per device × \times 4 accumulation steps) on a single NVIDIA T4 GPU. Each model is trained with seeds 42, 43 and 44. The recipe follows Rimal and Rimal [ 41 ] except for the batch size and the validation split. It was shared across models and tuned for none of them, so it may suit some models better than others. For Gemma-2-2B, Unsloth compilation was disabled ( UNSLOTH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1 ) in training and evaluation for all three seeds.
blocks.zh: 训练采用1×××时10−−−4的学习速率,有余弦衰变和200个热身步骤,8位亚当W,3个纪元(3,375个优化步),最大序列长度512个令牌,不包装,fp16,在单NVIDIA T4 GPU上有效批量尺寸8(每个装置2×××时4个积分步). 每个型号都经过了种子42,43和44的训练. 食谱遵循Rimal和Rimal[41],但批量大小和审定分拆除外. 它在模型之间被共享,并调用其中任何一个,因此它可能比其他模型更适合一些模型. 对于Gemma-2-2B,Unsloth编译器(UNSLOTH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1)在培训和评价所有三种种子时均被禁用.

blocks.en: 4.3 Checkpoint Selection and Divergence
blocks.zh: 4.3 检查站的选择和差异

blocks.en: We evaluate on the validation split every 100 steps and keep the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss; training is not stopped early. Appendix A lists every training run and its status. A second Qwen2.5-3B seed-42 run, launched because of a Kaggle session limit and to keep package versions the same across seeds, diverged: its validation loss jumped from 1.46 at step 1200 to 6.99 at step 1300, 4.8 times the best earlier value, before recovering. After it, we defined a run as diverged if any validation loss after step 500 exceeded 1.5 times the best earlier validation loss, and we report the first non-diverged run for each seed. The rule uses validation loss only, but it was fixed after the diverged run’s test scores had been seen, so it is a post hoc diagnostic rather than a pre-specified exclusion rule. No other run met it. The maximum post-step-500 ratio was 1.14–1.15 for Gemma-2-2B and 1.107–1.115 for Llama-3.1-8B; the retained records do not give the maxima for the other runs, and they give the selected step only for Qwen2.5-3B seeds 43 and 44 (step 2200 in both). Llama-3.2-3B seed 43 logged one non-finite gradient norm at step 2150, and training continued normally.
blocks.zh: 我们每100步评估一次验证,并将检查站的验证损失降到最低;培训没有及早停止。 附 录 A列出了每一次培训及其状况。 第二次Qwen2.5-3B种子-42运行,由于卡格会话限制而启动,为了让套件版本在种子间保持相同,出现差异:其验证损失从1200步的1.46跳跃到1300步的6.99跳跃,是早期最高值的4.8倍,然后恢复. 之后,我们将运行定义为,如果500步骤之后的任何验证损失超过先前最佳验证损失的1.5倍,则出现差异,我们报告每个种子的第一次未潜水运行。 该规则仅使用验证损失,但在看到不同运行的测试分数后就固定下来了,因此它是一个事后诊断,而不是预先规定的排除规则。 没有别的跑步遇到它。 Gemma-2-2B和Llama-31-8B的最大步后比分别为1.14–1.15和1.107–1.115;保留的记录并没有给出其他跑步的最大分数,它们只给出了Quen2.5-3B种子43和44(双双为2200步)的选步数. Llama-3.2-3B种子43在第2150步记录了一个非无限梯度规范,训练正常进行。

blocks.en: 4.4 Zero-Shot Conditions
blocks.zh: 4.4 零热条件

blocks.en: The zero-shot conditions use the base checkpoints without adapters under two prompts: (i) the Alpaca template used in fine-tuning, with its no-input variant where there is no input, and (ii) a bare prompt consisting of the instruction followed by the input on a new line. Each condition is a single deterministic run. The base models were not instructed to answer in Romanized Nepali, so these conditions measure what the models do with the task as given, not their best attainable zero-shot performance.
blocks.zh: 零镜头条件在两个提示下使用没有适配器的基点检查站: (一)在微调时使用的阿尔帕卡模板,在没有输入时使用其无输入变体; (二)赤色的提示,包括指示后在新线上输入. 每个条件都是一个决定性的运行。 基础模型没有被指示用罗马化的尼泊尔语回答,因此这些条件衡量模型按照给定的任务做什么,而不是它们所能达到的最佳零镜头性能.

blocks.en: 4.5 Decoding and Likelihood
blocks.zh: 4.5 解码和可能性

blocks.en: All conditions share decoding and scoring. We decode greedily with at most 256 new tokens and a repetition penalty of 1.1, in fp16 with batch size 8 and left padding; for fine-tuned models the adapter is applied to the 4-bit base without merging. Prompts are truncated to 512 tokens, a limit that no test prompt reached.
blocks.zh: 所有条件都共享解码和评分. 我们用最多256个新令牌和1.1的重复惩罚来解码,在fp16中,分批大小为8,并用左补丁;对于微调的模型,适配器被应用到4位基数上而不合并. 提示被缩短为512个符,这个限制没有达到测试提示.

blocks.en: We also score each reference response given its prompt by teacher forcing. For test item i , let NLL i be the summed negative log-likelihood, in nats, of the reference response tokens, excluding the end-of-sequence token, and let B i be the length of the reference in UTF-8 bytes. Prompt and response together are capped at 1,000 tokens, which truncated one item (id 289) under the Qwen and Llama tokenizers. Over the N = 1,000 test items, bits per byte is
blocks.zh: 我们还对每个参考答复进行评分,因为它是教师强迫造成的。 对于测试项目i,让NLL I作为引用响应符的负对数(nats)的汇总负对数,不包括序列结束符,让B i作为UTF-8字节的引用长度. 即时反应加起来以1 000个符号为上限,在Quen和Llama的标语器下划掉一个项目(id 289)。 N = 1 000个测试项目,每字节比值为

blocks.en: BPB = ∑ i = 1 N NLL i ln ⁡ 2 ​ ∑ i = 1 N B i \mathrm{BPB}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathrm{NLL}_{i}}{\ln 2\,\sum_{i=1}^{N}B_{i}} (1)

Because the denominator counts bytes rather than tokens, BPB can be compared across models with different tokenizers [ 11 ] ; lower values mean that the model assigns higher probability to the references. We also compute reference token perplexity, the exponential of the pooled NLL per response token, but compare it only within a model. BPB under the two zero-shot prompts is not compared, because the prompts condition the model differently.
blocks.zh: 由于分母计数字节而不是符号,BPB可以和不同的标注符进行跨模型的比较[11];较低的值意味着模型给引用分配较高的概率. 我们还计算参考符号的迷惑度,每个响应符号集合NLL的指数,但只在模型中比较. 两种零射速率下的BPB没有进行比较,因为速率对模型的条件不同.

blocks.en: 4.6 Generation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.6 代数

blocks.en: We report corpus-level BLEU [ 32 ] and chrF++ (character n-grams with word order 2) [ 36 ] , computed with sacreBLEU 2.6.0 [ 37 ] on a 0–100 scale (signatures in Appendix A ); ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L F-scores [ 26 ] , computed with the rouge-score package without stemming; and BERTScore F1 [ 49 ] with multilingual BERT (bert-base-multilingual-cased [ 7 ] ; bert-score 0.3.13, no baseline rescaling), averaged over items. Each test item has one reference. The BERTScore encoder was pretrained on text in which Nepali appears in Devanagari and has not been validated for Romanized Nepali, so we treat BERTScore as a supplementary similarity score. Empty generations are kept in every metric and score 0 in BERTScore; for runs with empty generations we also give the BERTScore mean over non-empty outputs as a descriptive supplement. Recomputing chrF++, BLEU, ROUGE and BPB from the saved per-item outputs reproduces the values of the evaluation scripts for every run (Appendix C ); BERTScore could not be recomputed in our analysis environment.
blocks.zh: 我们报告BLEU[32]和chrF++(带有词序的正克字符) 2) [36],按0-100的比例计算;ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L F分数[26],按不产生结果计算;BERTScore F1[49],按多语种BERT(BERT-Base-多语种案例[7];BERT-core 0.3.13,按项目平均计算。 每个测试项目有一个参考。 BERTScore编码器在文字上事先经过了训练,Nepali出现在Devanagari, 空子一代在每公分数中保存,在BERTScore中得分为0;对于空子一代的运行,我们还将BERTScore的平均值作为非空子产出的描述性补充。 从节省的每个项目产出中重新计算chrF++、BLEU、ROUGE和BPB,复制每一次运行的评价脚本的值(附录C);BERTScore无法在我们的分析环境中重新计算。

blocks.en: In our environment (bert-score 0.3.13 with Transformers 5.17.0), the evaluation script failed at the BERTScore step for zero-shot runs that contained at least one empty generation, after generation and likelihood scoring had finished. For these runs we rebuilt all text metrics from the saved outputs with a separate script that reuses the saved NLL values and bootstrap settings and does not regenerate. On the Qwen2.5-3B Alpaca run, which had no empty outputs, this script reproduced BLEU, chrF++, ROUGE and BPB exactly and BERTScore to within 10 − - 7 .
blocks.zh: 在我们的环境下(Bert-score 0.3.13与变形器 5.1.7.),评价脚本在BERTScore的0射程步骤上失败,在完成世代和概率分数后,至少包含一个空代. 对于这些运行,我们用一个单独的脚本重建了保存输出中的所有文本度量,该脚本重复了保存的NLL值和靴子设置,不会再生成. 在Wen2.5-3B号机上 阿尔帕卡运行,没有空输出,这个脚本将BLEU,chrF++,ROUGE和BPB精确复制到10 - - - 7范围内.

blocks.en: 4.7 Uncertainty
blocks.zh: 4.7 不确定性

blocks.en: We report two kinds of uncertainty. Variation across training seeds is given as the mean and sample standard deviation (SD) over three seeds; with three runs the SD itself is imprecise, since a 95% interval for the true SD runs from 0.52 to 6.3 times the sample SD. Test-set sampling variation is estimated by resampling the 1,000 test items from the saved outputs, which hold each generation, its reference and the reference NLL. Per-run 95% percentile intervals use 2,000 resamples (seed 0). To compare two models, we resample the items once per replicate (2,000 replicates, seed 0), recompute corpus chrF++, BLEU and pooled BPB for every seed of both models on the resampled items, average over each model’s seeds and take the difference. These paired item-level intervals condition on the trained seeds. As a complement that conditions on the test set instead, Table 9 also gives seed-level intervals (Welch’s t over the three per-seed scores of each model). Fertility intervals use 1,000 bootstrap resamples over references (seed 0) and paired fertility differences 2,000 resamples (seed 1). The evaluation scripts’ own per-run intervals used 200 resamples (Python random seed 0); the intervals reported here replace them. We do not interpret differences that neither kind of interval resolves.
blocks.zh: 我们报告两种不确定性。 跨训练种子的变异作为三个种子的平均值和样本标准偏差(SD)给出;三个运行SD本身是不精确的,因为真实SD的间隔从0.52倍到6.3倍的样本SD. 通过从节省的输出中重新取样1,000个测试项目,估计了测试集的采样变化,这些实验项目拥有每一代、其参考物和参考物NLL。 每运行95%的间隔使用2000个复标(种子0). 为了比较两个模型,我们每次复制一次(2,000次复制、种子0次)、再计算ChrF++、BLEU和集合BPB对两个模型的每个种子在复制品上进行再取样,平均比每个模型的种子多,并作出区别。 训练有素的种子上的这些配对品级间隔条件. 作为测试设备条件的补充,表9还给出了种子水平的间隔(Welch的t在每种模型的每种子分数中为3个)。 生育间隔使用1 000个靴子吊装在参考物上(种子0)和配对生育间隔2 000个吊装(种子1)。 评估脚本本身的每运行间隔使用200个复标(Python随机种子);这里报告的间隔替换它们. 我们不解释任何一种间隔都不能解决的分歧。

blocks.en: 4.8 Output Audit
blocks.zh: 4.8 产出审计

blocks.en: One script (SHA-256 69b88899…) audits every saved output. It flags (i) English-like output, when English stopwords make up at least 15% of alphabetic tokens, using a fixed 111-word list screened against the reference responses; (ii) input copying, when the first non-empty line, of at least three words, reproduces a non-template line of the prompt; and (iii) repetition loops, when at least half of the non-empty lines repeat earlier lines, for outputs of at least three lines. The English and loop checks apply only to outputs long enough to evaluate, so their denominators vary. The same definitions apply to all 20 evaluation runs. As a descriptive baseline, the audit of the 1,000 reference responses flags none of 922 evaluable responses as English-like, 10 as input copies and 1 of 181 evaluable as a repetition loop. Because the stopword list was screened against these references, the baseline does not validate the English flag independently. The flags are surface heuristics, not judgments of correctness: English words can be appropriate in code or explanations, and repeated lines can occur in valid structured answers.
blocks.zh: 1个脚本(SHA-256 69b88899....)对每个节省的产出进行审计. 它标注(一)类似英文的输出,当英文的止字至少占字母符号的15%时,使用对照参考回复筛选的固定的111字列表; (二)输入复制,当第一个非空行,至少三个字时,复制一个不模版的提示行; (三)重复循环,当至少一半非空行重复先前的行,对于输出,至少三个行. 英文和循环检查只适用于足够长的时间来评价的产出,因此其分母不同. 同样的定义适用于所有20项评价。 作为描述性基准,对1 000份参考答复的审计显示,922份可评价答复中没有一个是英文式的,10份是输入副本,181份中有一个是可评价的重复循环。 由于停止字列表是对照这些引用来筛选的,基线并不能独立验证英国国旗. 旗帜为表层heuristic,而非正确性的判断:英语单词在代码或解释上可以合适,重复行可以在有效的结构化答案中发生.

blocks.en: 4.9 Software and Provenance
blocks.zh: 4.9 软件和证据

blocks.en: The primary fine-tuned evaluations used evaluation script v2.2 and the Llama-3.1-8B evaluations v2.4 (51e1bd41…). The fine-tuned code path (prompt template, generation settings, likelihood scoring and metrics) is identical in the two versions; v2.4 adds the two zero-shot prompt modes, saves generations before computing metrics, and corrects a field that left the v2.2 metric files recording their script hash as unknown. The zero-shot runs of the primary models used one script (33e10eac…) with per-run overrides; Appendix A lists which patched copies have recorded hashes. Package versions differed across sessions (Appendix A ). To check that this does not change results, we re-evaluated Qwen2.5-3B seed 43 in a later environment (Unsloth 2026.11.2, Transformers 5.17.0, PEFT 0.21.2 and PyTorch built for CUDA 13.0): all 1,000 generations, all per-item NLL values and every metric were identical. This check covers one adapter. The training and evaluation code, the re-analysis of the saved outputs (Sections 5.2 – 5.6 and Appendix C ), the tokenizer and romanization analysis (Section 5.1 and Appendix B ) and the figure code were written with the assistance of an AI model (Acknowledgments).
blocks.zh: 初级微调评价使用评价脚本v2.2和Llama-3.1-8B评价v2.4(51e1bd41. 微调的代码路径(即时模板,生成设置,概率评分和度量衡)在两个版本中是完全相同的;v2.4增加了两个零射速率的速率模式,在计算度量值之前节省了几代人,并修正了一个字段,这个字段留下的v2.2度量文件记录了他们的脚本散列为未知. 初级模型的零镜头运行使用了一个脚本(33e10eac...),每个运行的覆盖;补丁副本的附录A列表记录了散列. 套件版本因会议而异(附录A )。 为了检查这是否没有改变结果,我们重新评估了以后环境中的Quen2.5-3B种子43(Unsloth 2026.11.2,变形金刚5.1.7,PEFT 02.1.2和为CUDA 13.0建造的PyTorch):所有1000代,每个项目NLL值和每个公尺都是相同的. 此检查覆盖一个适配器 。 培训和评价守则、对节省的产出的重新分析(第5.2至5.6节和附录C)、标注剂和罗马化分析(第5.1节和附录B)以及图码是在AI模型(承认)的协助下编写的。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Tokenizer Fertility on Romanized Nepali
blocks.zh: 5.1 罗马化尼泊尔语生育率

blocks.en: On the 1,000 test references (41,388 words), each encoded whole without special tokens, the Gemma-2-2B tokenizer has the lowest fertility, 2.717 tokens per word, followed by Llama-3.2-3B (2.938) and Qwen2.5-3B (2.997) (Table 3 ). Medians and tokens per character give the same order, and paired bootstrap differences confirm it: Llama exceeds Gemma by 0.221 [0.206, 0.235], Qwen exceeds Llama by 0.059 [0.051, 0.067], and Qwen exceeds Gemma by 0.280 [0.268, 0.292]. Per reference, Llama’s tokenizer needed fewer tokens per word than Gemma’s for only 9.1% of the references, and Qwen’s for only 4.5%. The Mistral-7B-v0.1 tokenizer, which we did not fine-tune, splits words more (3.295). The Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.2-3B tokenizers produced identical token IDs for all 1,000 references, as did the Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen3-8B tokenizers. Among the trained models the range is narrow: 2.72–3.00 tokens per word, a 10% spread.
blocks.zh: 在1000个测试参考文献(41,388个字)上,每个编码的整件没有特别的代号,Gemma-2-2B的代号器的生育率最低,每字2.717个代号,其次是Llama-3.2-3B(2.938)和Quen2.5-3B(2.997)(表3). 每个字符的中位数和符号给出相同的顺序,配对的靴子差异证实了这一点:Llama比Gemma多0.221 [0.206,0.235],Quen比Llama多0.059 [0.051,0.067],Quen比Gemma多0.280 [0.268,0.292]. 与Gemma相比, Llama 的标语比Gemma的标语要少9.1%, 而Quen的标语则只有4.5%。 我们没有微调的Mistral-7B-v0.1标语器将单词划分得更多(3.295). Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.2-3B的代号为所有1000个参考物都产生了相同的代号ID,Quen2.5-3B和Quen3-8B的代号也是一样. 在经过培训的模型中,范围很窄:每字2.72-3.00个符号,分布率为10%。

blocks.en: Table 3: Tokenizer fertility on the 1,000 benchmark references (41,388 words) beside the three-seed fine-tuned results. Fertility is the mean over references of tokens per whitespace-delimited word, with 95% bootstrap intervals (1,000 resamples). Higher chrF++ and lower BPB are better. Mistral-7B-v0.1 was not trained here.
blocks.zh: 表3:除三种子微调结果外,在1 000个基准参照数(41 388字)上显示的托肯泽尔生育率。 生育率是平均高于每个白空间有限字的符号参考值,95%的靴子间隔(1 000个复标)。 更高的chrF++和较低的BPB更好. 米斯特拉尔-7B-v0.1未在此受训.

blocks.en: Because the benchmark references are themselves in one romanization scheme, we also measured fertility on public Nepali text under the three conventions of Section 3.2 (Table 4 ; details in Appendix B ). The sample comprises 1,233 sentences: 1,146 from the Mozilla Common Voice Nepali text corpus [ 2 ] and 87 lines of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in Nepali distributed with NLTK [ 4 ] . Under the benchmark scheme (R2), tokens per character on this sample (0.339–0.420) are close to those on the benchmark references (0.341–0.419), but fertility is lower (2.13–2.65), because the sample’s words are shorter (about 6.4 against 7.9 characters per word, counting the following space). The tokenizer files used for this sample reproduce the Hugging Face token counts exactly on all 1,000 benchmark references (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 由于基准参考本身是一个罗马化计划,我们还根据3.2节的三个公约(表4;详见附录B),用尼泊尔的公开文本衡量生育率。 样本包括1,233句:1,146句来自Mozilla共同之声尼泊尔语文本库[2]和87行《世界人权宣言》尼泊尔语文本,与NLTK[4]一起分发。 根据基准方案(R2),这个样本上每个字符的代号(0.339–0.420)与基准参考号(0.341-0.419)的代号接近,但生育率较低(2.13–2.65),因为样本中的单词较短(约每字6.4对7.9个字符,计及以下空格). 用于这个样本的标致文件复制了Hugging Face标志,精确地计算了所有1000个基准参考文献(附录B ).

blocks.en: Table 4: Fertility on a public sample of 1,233 Nepali sentences under three romanization conventions: R1, case-preserving ITRANS; R2, lowercased ITRANS (the benchmark scheme); R3, R2 without the final inherent vowel in words of two or more aksharas. Word shares are over 8,840 running words under R2. Bootstrap intervals have a half-width of 0.03–0.04 under every convention.
blocks.zh: 表4:在三种罗马化公约下公开抽样的1,233个尼泊尔语句子的生育率:R1,保留案例的ITRANS;R2,小写ITRANS(基准方案);R3,R2,没有两个或两个以上akhara语词中最终固有元音. R2下的单词共享超过8,840个运行中的单词. 每一公约的靴子间隔为0.03-0.04。

blocks.en: The order Gemma < Llama < Qwen < Mistral held in all 2,000 paired bootstrap resamples under every convention. The convention, however, changed fertility about as much as the choice of tokenizer did. Lowercasing (R1 to R2) lowered fertility by 12.7–14.4%, or 0.35–0.41 tokens per word, which approaches the full spread across the four tokenizers under R2 (0.51) and is more than ten times the Llama–Qwen difference (0.029). Dropping the final inherent vowel (R2 to R3) lowered it by a further 3.1–4.2%. Gemma’s lower fertility comes from keeping more words whole: under R2, 30.9% of running words are a single Gemma token, against 19.0–22.4% for the other tokenizers, and 31.6% are split into three or more tokens, against 39.7–49.7%.
blocks.zh: Gemma < Llama < Quen < Mistral号订单在每届大会下的所有2,000对靴子的重新印章中保存。 但是,公约对生育力的改变与对象征性剂的选择一样大。 降低生育率(R1至R2)将生育率降低12.7-14.4%,即每字0.35-0.41个令牌,这接近在R2(0.51)下在四个标志剂中的全部分布,是Llama–Qwen差值(0.029)的十倍以上。 将最终固有元音(R2至R3)进一步降低3.1-4.2%. Gemma的低生育率来自于保留更多词的完整:在R2下,30.9%的运行词是单一的Gemma符号,而其他的标致词是19.0–22.4 %,31.6%被分成3个或更多个符号,而39.7–49.7 %.

blocks.en: Fertility did not correspond to the fine-tuned results (Table 3 ). Gemma-2-2B, whose tokenizer splits words least, has the lowest overlap scores and the highest BPB of the three models (Section 5.3 ), and Llama-3.2-3B has the lowest BPB although its tokenizer splits words more than Gemma’s. With three trained models that also differ in size, data and architecture (Table 2 ), this is a counterexample to choosing models by fertility, not an estimate of its effect.
blocks.zh: 生育率与微调的结果不符(表3)。 Gemma-2-2B的标语分数最少, 重叠分数最少, 且是三种模式(第5.3节)中最高的BPB, Llama-3.2-3B的标语分数最低, 三个训练有素的模型在体积、数据和结构上也有所不同(表2),这是按生育率选择模型的反例,而不是对模型效果的估计。

blocks.en: 5.2 Zero-Shot Behaviour
blocks.zh: 5.2 零发热行为

blocks.en: Without adaptation, all three base models score far below their fine-tuned versions (Table 5 ). chrF++ is 10.1–13.7, against 29.0–30.6 after fine-tuning, and BPB under the Alpaca prompt is 2.23–2.41, against 0.78–0.84. Most zero-shot outputs are not Romanized Nepali at all: 543–923 of 1,000 outputs per condition (54.3–92.3%) are flagged as English-like, against none of the evaluable references (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 没有调整,所有三个基模型的得分都远低于其微调版本(表5). chrF++是10.1–13.7,而微调后为29.0–30.6,阿尔帕卡速率下的BPB是2.23–2.41,而0.78–0.84. 大多数零镜头产出根本没有罗马化的尼泊尔语:每个条件的1 000个产出中有543-923个(54.3-92.3%)被标为类似英文,而不是任何可评价的参考文献(表6)。

blocks.en: Table 5: Zero-shot results on the 1,000 test items (one deterministic run per condition). Empty generations are kept and score 0 in BERTScore; the mean over non-empty outputs is in parentheses. BPB is comparable across models within a prompt, not across prompts.
blocks.zh: 表5:1000个试验项目零射结果(每个条件一次确定运行). 空代保存,在BERTSCore中得分为0;平均值大于非空产出在括号中。 BPB在瞬间而不是瞬间在模型中具有可比性。

blocks.en: The effect of the prompt depends on the model. For Qwen2.5-3B the Alpaca prompt gives higher chrF++ (13.65 [13.32, 13.98] against 11.45 [11.04, 11.86]) and BERTScore, and a higher BLEU point estimate with overlapping intervals (0.64 [0.52, 0.77] against 0.43 [0.29, 0.60]). For Llama-3.2-3B, chrF++ is similar under the two prompts (12.51 and 12.65), while BLEU and BERTScore are higher with the Alpaca template. Gemma-2-2B has lower chrF++ under the Alpaca prompt (10.13 against 10.96) but higher BLEU and BERTScore. We report these as point estimates and do not claim that the smaller differences are reliable. Qwen2.5-3B’s bare-prompt BERTScore of 0.492 includes 91 empty generations scored as 0; over its 909 non-empty outputs the mean is 0.541, close to its Alpaca value. Likelihood already orders the base models: under both prompts, BPB is lowest for Llama-3.2-3B and highest for Gemma-2-2B, and every paired difference is resolved.
blocks.zh: 提示的效果取决于模型. 用于Quen2.5-3B 阿尔帕卡提示给出了更高的chrF++(13.65 [13.32, 13.98]相对于11.45 [11.04, 11.86])和BERTScore, 更高的BLEU点估计值,间隔重叠(0.64 [0.52, 0.77]相对于0.43 [0.29, 0.60]). 对于Llama-3.2-3B,chrF++在两个提示(12.51和12.65)下类似,而用Alpaca模板BLEU和BERTScore则更高. Gemma-2-2B在阿尔帕卡速率(10.13对10.96)下具有较低的chrF++,但比BLEU和BERTScore更高. 我们把这些报告作为点估计,并不声称较小的差异是可靠的。 Wen2.5-3B的光速BERTS分数0.492包括91个空代得分为0;在其909个非空的输出中,平均值为0.541,接近其阿尔帕卡值。 相似性已经订购了基型:在两种提示下,Llama-3.2-3B的BPB最低,Gemma-2-2B最高,每个对对的差都得到解决.

blocks.en: The failures differ by model and prompt (Table 6 ). Llama-3.2-3B copied the prompt in 135 outputs under the Alpaca template, mostly on type B items (24.2% of type B outputs), and produced 110 repetition loops under the bare prompt (16.4% of type B outputs). Qwen2.5-3B produced 91 empty generations and 29 loops under the bare prompt, against none and 2 under the Alpaca template. Gemma-2-2B produced few copying or repetition flags under either prompt, and the most English-like output across the two prompts (830 and 877). Where the audit breaks failures down by type, they concentrate on type B prompts, whose instructions are themselves Romanized. After fine-tuning, the nine runs had 0–2 English-like flags, 4–20 input copies (0.4–2.0%), 0–2 loops and no empty generations, rates comparable to those of the references. The flagged fine-tuned outputs that we inspected mostly answered prompts whose references are themselves structured or code (an HTML table, SQL, JavaScript or numbered lists) or contain quoted English words.
blocks.zh: 失败情况因模式和及时性而异(表6)。 Llama-3.2-3B在阿尔帕卡模板下复制了135个产出中的提示,大部分是B类项目(占B类产出的24.2%),并在光速提示下产生了110个重复循环(占B类产出的16.4%)。 Quen2.5-3B在赤速率下共生产了91个空代和29个环,在阿尔帕卡模板下对无和2. Gemma-2-2B在两种速率下都很少产生复制或重复的旗帜,在两种速率(830和877)下最像英语的输出. 当审计按类型分解失败时,它们会专注于B型提示,其指令本身就是罗马化的. 经过微调后,这九行有0–2的英式旗帜,4–20的输入拷贝(0.4–2.0 %),0–2的循环和没有空代,率与参考文献的相当. 我们所检查的标记的微调输出大多答复了引用本身结构或代码的提示(HTML表、SQL、JavaScript或编号列表)或包含引用的英文单词。

blocks.en: Table 6: Output audit (heuristic flags, not quality judgments). Counts are out of 1,000 outputs unless an evaluable denominator is shown; the English and loop checks apply only to outputs long enough to evaluate.
blocks.zh: 表6:产出审计(高压旗帜,而不是质量判断)。 除非显示可评价分母,否则计数将超过1 000项产出;英文和循环检查仅适用于足够长的可评价产出。

blocks.en: 5.3 Adaptation across Model Families
blocks.zh: 5.3 模范家庭的适应

blocks.en: All three models adapt strongly (Table 7 ). Mean chrF++ rises to 29.02–30.61 and BPB falls to 0.779–0.842, with no empty outputs and few audit flags. Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B cannot be separated on any generation metric: their mean chrF++ differs by 0.09 points, BLEU by 0.04 and ROUGE-1 by 0.001, and their seed ranges overlap (chrF++ 29.53–31.42 and 29.97–31.38). Gemma-2-2B is lower on every overlap metric. Its BLEU separates cleanly, with all three seeds (4.51–4.99) below every Qwen and Llama seed (5.61 or above), whereas its chrF++ overlaps: its best seed (29.73) exceeds the lowest Qwen seed (29.53). BERTScore differs little between models (0.750–0.757). All three models score higher on type A than on type B, by 2.4–2.8 chrF++ points (type A 30.25–31.92, type B 27.83–29.40), and BPB is lower on type A in every model.
blocks.zh: 所有三种模型都进行了有力的调整(表7)。 平均chrF++上升到29.02–30.61,BPB下降到0.779–0.842,没有空产出,审计旗也很少. Wen2.5-3B和Llama-3.2-3B不能在任何一代的度量衡上分离:它们的平均值chrF++差0.09分,BLEU差0.04分,ROUGE-1差0.001分,它们的种子范围重叠(chrF++ 29.53–31.42和29.97–31.38). Gemma-2-2B在每一个重叠度量标准上都较低. 它的BLEU分清了,所有三个种子(4.51–4.99)都低于每个Quen和Llama种子(5.61或以上),而它的chrF++重叠:其最佳种子(29.73)超过了最低的Quen种子(29.53). BERTScore在模型之间差别不大(0.750–0.757). 所有三种型号在A型比B型的得分都更高,分别以2.4–2.8 chrF++分(A型30.25–31.92,B型27.83–29.40),BPB在每个型号中A型的得分较低.

blocks.en: Table 7: Fine-tuned results on the 1,000 test items: mean ± \pm sample SD over seeds 42, 43 and 44. Higher is better except for BPB. Qwen2.5-3B seed 42 is the first non-diverged run (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 表7:1000项测试项目的精细调整结果:平均值 ±\\pm 样本SD大于种子42,43和44. 除了BPB以外,更高的更好. Quen2.5-3B种子42是首个未跳水的跑步(第4.3节).

blocks.en: Gains over the zero-shot baselines depend on the baseline prompt (Table 8 , Figure 1 ). Measured from the Alpaca-prompt baseline, chrF++ rises by 16.95 (Qwen2.5-3B) to 18.89 (Gemma-2-2B) points among the small models and by 21.30 for Llama-3.1-8B. Measured from the bare-prompt baseline, Qwen2.5-3B gains most (19.16) and Llama-3.1-8B least (17.77). The models with the largest and smallest gains thus swap places. Because each model’s fine-tuned score is the same in both columns, these changes come entirely from the zero-shot runs. Under the bare prompt, three of the four gains lie within 0.3 points of one another, well inside seed variation, and BLEU gains give yet another order under each prompt. Likelihood gives a steadier picture: every model’s fine-tuned BPB is 0.341–0.358 of its zero-shot value under either prompt, a 64–66% reduction, and the BPB order of the four models is the same before and after fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 零射线基线的收益取决于基准速率(表8,图1)。 根据阿尔帕卡-瞬态基线测量,chrF++在小模型中上升了16.95(Quen2.5-3B)至18.89(Gemma-2-2B)点,Llama-3.1-8B则上升了21.30. 根据光速基线测量,Quen2.5-3B收益最多(19.16),Llama-3.1-8B收益最少(17.77)。 收益最大和最小的模型因此互换了位置。 由于每个模型的微调分数在两列都相同,这些变化完全来自于零射线跑. 在光速下,四个收益中有三个在彼此0.3点以内,远在种子变异内,而BLEU收益在每个速率下又给出了另一个顺序. 相似性给出了一个更稳定的图景:每个模型的微调BPB在任何一种速率下都是0.341–0.358的零射值,降低64–66 %,而四个模型的BPB顺序在微调前后是相同的.

blocks.en: Table 8: Gains from zero-shot to fine-tuned: the three-seed fine-tuned mean minus the single zero-shot run under each prompt, and the ratio of fine-tuned to zero-shot BPB under each prompt. Computed from Tables 5 , 7 and 10 before rounding.
blocks.zh: 表8:从零镜头到微调的增益:三种子微调是指减去每个提示下单次零镜头运行,在每个提示下微调到零镜头BPB的比例. 按四舍五入前的表5、表7和表10计算。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Gain in chrF++ from zero-shot to fine-tuned, measured from the Alpaca-prompt and the bare-prompt zero-shot baselines. Lines connect the same model. Each model’s fine-tuned score is the same in both columns; only the baseline changes.
blocks.zh: 图1:ChrF++的增益,从零射入微调,从阿尔帕卡瞬间和赤射入零射入基线测得. 线路连接同一型号. 每个模型的微调分数在两栏中相同;只有基准变化.

blocks.en: 5.4 Training Stability and Seed Variation
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训稳定性和种子变化

blocks.en: Seed variation is of the same size as test-set variation. Seed SDs of chrF++ are 0.62–0.97 points, and the 95% bootstrap interval of a single fine-tuned run is 1.7–2.0 points wide. Table 9 shows what the two kinds of interval can resolve. Paired item-level comparisons resolve Gemma-2-2B’s deficits in chrF++ and BLEU against both other small models and Llama-3.1-8B’s small gains over Llama-3.2-3B, but not the difference between Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen2.5-3B (chrF++ − - 0.09 [ − - 0.50, 0.31]). Seed-level intervals are wider: they resolve no chrF++ difference, and for BLEU only Gemma-2-2B’s deficits and the 8B gain. Differences of about one chrF++ point between single runs are therefore not interpretable, and even three-seed means need a paired test. Training was stable apart from the one diverged Qwen2.5-3B replicate (Section 4.3 ). After step 500, validation loss rose to at most 1.15 times its best earlier value for Gemma-2-2B and 1.115 times for Llama-3.1-8B; selection on the validation split keeps the earlier, better checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 种子变异与测试集变异大小相同. chrF++的种子SD为0.62–0.97分,单次微调运行的95%的靴子间隔为1.7–2.0分宽. 表9显示两种间隔能够解决什么. Paired项级比较解决了Gemma-2-2B在chrF++和BLEU中与其他小模型和Llama-31-8B相比在Llama-3.2-3B上的小收益的赤字,但不解决Llama-3.2-3B和Quen2.5-3B(chrF++− - - 0.09 [−-0.50,0.31])之间的差额. 种子水平间隔更宽:它们解决不了chrF++差,对BLEU来说只有Gemma-2-2B的赤字和8B增益. 因此,单次运行之间大约1个chrF++点的差异是无法解释的,甚至三种子意味着需要一对测试. 培训是稳定的,除了重复的Quen2.5-3B(第4.3节)。 在500步骤之后,验证损失最多增至Gemma-2-2B的1.15倍,Llama-3.1-8B的1.115倍;在验证分割上的选择保留了较早的更好的检查站。

blocks.en: Table 9: Differences between models (first model minus second) with two kinds of 95% interval. Paired item-level: the 1,000 test items resampled 2,000 times, scores recomputed for every seed and averaged over each model’s seeds; it conditions on the trained seeds. Seed-level: Welch intervals over the three per-seed scores of each model; it conditions on the test set. Negative BPB differences mean higher likelihood for the first model. Intervals in bold exclude zero.
blocks.zh: 表9 模型之间的差异(第一模型减去第二模型),两种模型间隔为95%. Paired项目级别:1,000个测试项目重新进行了2,000次检测,每个种子的得分重新计算,每个模型的种子平均得分;这取决于训练有素的种子。 种子级别 : 韦尔奇在每种型号的每种子3个分数之间间隔;它在测试集上附加条件. 负BPB差异意味着第一个模型的可能性更高. 黑体中的间距排除0。

blocks.en: 5.5 Reference Likelihood against Generation Overlap
blocks.zh: 5.5 与世代重叠相对应的可能性

blocks.en: Likelihood and generation overlap give different pictures of how the adapted models compare (Figure 2 , Table 9 ). Every BPB difference between models is resolved by both kinds of interval, and the order holds in every seed. At the item level, the generation metrics separate every pair except one: Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen2.5-3B, the pair with the largest BPB gap among the small models (0.0423), cannot be separated on chrF++ or BLEU, nor on ROUGE or BERTScore. Gemma-2-2B’s BPB deficit relative to Qwen2.5-3B is half as large (0.0205) but comes with the largest generation gap ( − - 1.59 chrF++, − - 1.08 BLEU). The size of a likelihood gap therefore predicted neither the size nor the presence of a generation gap. By likelihood, Llama-3.2-3B is the best of the three small models; by generation overlap, it ties with Qwen2.5-3B. The two kinds of measure agree only on placing Gemma-2-2B last. Output length does not explain the pattern. Fine-tuned outputs were shorter than the references for every model (78–79% of their length in characters on average), 3–8% of them ran to the 256-token limit, and the two models that tie on generation also match on length (both 79%). Because BPB is normalized by bytes, these differences are not an artefact of how many tokens each tokenizer produces, although they may still reflect tokenization together with the models’ other differences.
blocks.zh: 相似性和世代重叠提供了不同的图片,说明经过调整的模型如何比较(图2,表9)。 模型之间的每个BPB差异都通过两种间隔解决,顺序在每一个种子中都保持. 在项目层面,除一对外,生成度量衡将每对:Llama-3.2-3B和Quen2.5-3B,小模型中BPB差距最大的一对(0.0423)无法在chrF++或BLEU上分离,也不能在ROUGE或BERTScore上分离. Gemma-2-2B相对于Quen2.5-3B的BPB赤字是大(0.0205)的一半,但出现最大的发电缺口(− - 1.59 chrF++,− - 1.08 BLEU). 因此,可能性差距的大小既不预测其大小,也不预测代数差距的存在。 从概率看,Llama-3.2-3B是三个小模型中最好的;通过世代重叠,它与Quen2.5-3B相连. 这两种措施只同意把Gemma-2-2B放在最后. 输出长度不能解释模式. 精细调整的输出比每个模型的参考值短(平均为字符长度的78-79%),其中3-8 % 跑到了256个托肯的极限,与世代挂钩的两个模型也在长度上吻合(均为79%)。 由于BPB通过字节实现常态化,这些差异并不是每个标致器产生多少个符号的动词,尽管它们可能仍然会与模型的其他差异一起反映标致化.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Fine-tuned reference likelihood (BPB; lower means higher likelihood) against (a) chrF++ and (b) BLEU. Points are three-seed means and bars show ± \pm 1 seed SD. Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen2.5-3B differ clearly in BPB but in neither generation metric.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 微调参考概率(BPB;较低是指较高概率),与(a) chrF++和(b) BLEU相对。 点是三种子手段,栏杆显示±\pm 1种子SD. Llama-3.2-3B和Qwen2.5-3B在BPB中明显不同,但在两个生成度量衡中都没有.

blocks.en: 5.6 Within-Family Comparison with Llama-3.1-8B
blocks.zh: 5.6 家庭内部与Llama-3.1-8B的比较

blocks.en: Llama-3.1-8B tokenizes the references identically to Llama-3.2-3B, which removes segmentation as a source of difference between the two, although they differ in model generation, training data and distillation as well as size (Table 2 ). After fine-tuning (Table 10 ), the 8B model has lower BPB in every seed, by 0.0530 [0.0501, 0.0559] in the paired comparison. Its gains in generation are small: 0.68 chrF++ and 0.58 BLEU points. Both are resolved by the paired item-level test (chrF++ [0.26, 1.10], BLEU [0.17, 1.09]), but only the BLEU gain is consistent across seeds: every 8B seed has higher BLEU than every 3B seed (6.20–6.54 against 5.72–5.91), whereas the 3B seed-43 run (chrF++ 31.38) scores above two of the three 8B runs. BERTScore differs by 0.005. The type A advantage holds in every 8B seed (chrF++ 32.47, 32.00 and 33.30 on type A against 29.15, 29.60 and 30.74 on type B). The audit shows no empty generations and no Devanagari output in the three 8B runs, with 0, 3 and 0 English-like outputs, 9, 13 and 9 input copies and 2, 2 and 4 repetition loops, similar to Llama-3.2-3B.
blocks.zh: Llama-3.1-8B对Llama-3.2-3B的引用以相同的符号表示,它消除了作为两者差异来源的分化,尽管它们在模型生成、培训数据和蒸馏以及大小上有所不同(表2)。 经过微调(表10)后,8B型机车在每个种子中的BPB都较低,比对比中0.0530 [0.0501,0.0559]. 它的生成收益很小:0.68 chrF++和0.58 BLEU点. 两者均通过配对的品级测试(chrF++[0.26,1.10],BLEU[0.17,1.09])解决,但只有BLEU的得分在种子间一致:每8B种子的BLEU比每3B种子(6.20–6.54对5.72–5.91)高,而3B种子-43运行(chrF++31.38)的得分高于3B运行中的2分. BERTSCore 与 005 不同。 A型优势在每8B种种子中占据(crF++ 32.47,32.00和33.30在A型对29.15,29.60和30.74在B型). 审计显示在3个8B运行中没有空代和Devanagari输出,有0,3和0个英文类输出,9,13和9个输入拷贝和2,2和4个重复循环,类似于Llama-3.2-3B.

blocks.en: Without fine-tuning the likelihood gap is larger, but generation does not follow it. The 8B model’s BPB is lower by 0.198 [0.192, 0.203] under the Alpaca prompt and by 0.194 [0.189, 0.199] under the bare prompt, while its chrF++ is lower under the Alpaca prompt (9.89 against 12.51) and higher under the bare prompt (13.42 against 12.65). Under the Alpaca prompt the 8B model returned 141 empty generations, 128 of them on type B items, against 4 for the 3B model; we did not investigate the cause. In sum, the larger model assigns higher probability to the references before and after fine-tuning, but after fine-tuning its outputs are only slightly closer to them, by 0.68 chrF++ and 0.58 BLEU points, and only the BLEU gain is consistent across seeds.
blocks.zh: 不进行微调,可能性差距就更大了,但世代不遵循. 8B型机车的BPB在阿尔帕卡快车下降低0.198 [0.192,0.203],在赤速车下降低0.194 [0.189,0.199],而其chrF++在阿尔帕卡快车下降低(9.89对12.51),在赤速车下提高(13.42对12.65). 在阿尔帕卡(Alpaca)的催促下,8B模型将141个空代归还,其中128个属于B类,而3B模型为4;我们没有调查原因. 总而言之,较大的模型在微调前后给参考物分配了更高的概率,但在微调后其输出值仅略接近它们,以0.68 chrF++和0.58 BLEU点表示,只有BLEU增益在种子之间是一致的.

blocks.en: Table 10: Llama-3.1-8B against Llama-3.2-3B. Fine-tuned rows: mean ± \pm sample SD over seeds 42, 43 and 44 (8B per seed: chrF++ 30.79, 30.78 and 32.00; BLEU 6.20, 6.46 and 6.54; BPB 0.7263, 0.7274 and 0.7236). Zero-shot rows: single runs, with the BERTScore mean over non-empty outputs in parentheses. BPB is comparable across models within a condition, not across zero-shot prompts.
blocks.zh: 表10:Llama-3.1-8B对Llama-3.2-3B. 精细整齐的行:在种子42,43和44(每种子8B:chrF++30.79,30.78和32.00;BLEU 6.20,6.46和6.54;BPB 0.7263,0.7274和0.7236)上标本SD. 零射线:单跑,括号内为BERTScore表示大于非空输出. BPB在条件范围内是可比较的模型,而不是零射速率.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 What Likelihood and Generation Overlap Each Show
blocks.zh: 6.1 每场演出都会出现什么可能性和世代重叠

blocks.en: Across the four adapted models, BPB separated every pair. The overlap metrics separated every pair except Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen2.5-3B, which had the largest likelihood gap among the small models. The two kinds of measure answer different questions. BPB measures how probable a model finds one human-written response under teacher forcing; chrF++ and BLEU measure how close the model’s own greedy output is to that response.
blocks.zh: 在四个经过改造的模型中,BPB将每对分开. 除了Llama-3.2-3B和Quen2.5-3B以外,重叠的度量衡将每一对都分开,后者在小模型中的可能性差距最大。 此二种度量答不同问. BPB 度量模型在教师强迫下如何找到一个人写反应;chrF++和BLEU度量模型自身贪婪的输出与该反应的距离.

blocks.en: Several mechanisms could produce the gap, and our design does not test them. Teacher-forced scoring conditions each token on the reference prefix, whereas free-running greedy decoding conditions on the model’s own earlier choices, so a model can rank the reference well without producing it. With one reference per item, many adequate responses score poorly on overlap, which adds noise that likelihood does not have. Greedy decoding with a 256-token limit and a repetition penalty changes the generated text in ways that likelihood scoring does not see, and the 9–12% of references that are longer than the limit cannot be matched in full by any model; output length itself, however, was similar across models (Section 5.5 ). Distillation could also play a part: Llama-3.2-3B was pretrained with token-level targets from larger Llama models [ 30 ] . Gemma-2-2B was also distilled [ 12 ] yet has the highest BPB, so distillation alone does not explain the pattern.
blocks.zh: 有几个机制可以产生这种差距,我们的设计没有加以检验。 教师强制在参考前缀上附加每个符号的评分条件,而自由运行的贪婪的解码条件则在模型自己的早期选择上,因此模型可以在不产生参考的情况下对参考物进行很好的排序. 就每个项目而言,许多适当的答复在重叠上评分不佳,这增加了可能没有的噪音。 以256个托肯限制和重复处罚进行贪婪的解码会改变生成的文本,其可能评分看不到,超过限额的9-12%的参考文献无法与任何模型完全匹配;然而,产出长度本身在各模型之间类似(第5.5节)。 蒸馏也可以发挥一定的作用:Llama-3.2-3B从更大的Llama型号中预训了标语级目标[30]. Gemma-2-2B也被蒸馏[12],然而其BPB最高,因此单蒸馏并不能解释模式.

blocks.en: Meister and Cotterell [ 28 ] argued that perplexity does not characterize the text a model generates; with byte normalization, the dissociation holds even though likelihood is compared across different tokenizers. The practical consequence is that neither kind of measure can stand in for the other: a study that selected among our models by likelihood would have preferred Llama-3.2-3B over Qwen2.5-3B, and one that selected by chrF++ would have found no difference. The evidence comes from four models and one test set.
blocks.zh: Meister和Cotterell [28] 认为,模具生成的文本不具有复杂性;随着字节的正常化,即使不同标注符之间比较了可能性,分离仍然具有存在。 其实际后果是,这两种措施都无法替代另一种:一项根据可能性从我们的模型中挑选出来的研究会比Quen2.5-3B更偏爱Llama-3.2-3B,另一项由chrF++选定的研究不会发现任何区别. 证据来自四个模型和一个测试集.

blocks.en: 6.2 What Tokenizer Fertility Can and Cannot Indicate
blocks.zh: 6.2 助推器生育率能够和无法显示的内容

blocks.en: Fertility ranked the tokenizers consistently, on the benchmark references and under three romanization conventions, but it did not identify the best model: the tokenizer that split words least belonged to the model that scored lowest. Three points limit what this shows. The range among the trained models was narrow (2.72–3.00 tokens per word), far from the many-fold differences between languages [ 34 ] or between native and romanized scripts [ 17 ] for which fertility is known to matter. The models differ in much more than the tokenizer (Table 2 ). And fertility itself depended on the romanization convention about as much as on the tokenizer (Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 生育率在基准参考文献和三项罗马化公约下,始终将象征性词排在首位,但它没有确定最佳模式:将词分词最少的标志词属于得分最低的模式。 三分限制了这个显示。 训练有素的模型的范围很窄(每字2.72-3.00个符号),远非各语言之间或当地文字和罗马文字之间有多重差异,而众所周知,这些差异对生育率很重要。 模型的差异远大于标注器(表2)。 生育力本身取决于罗马化公约,与象征剂一样多(第5.1节)。

blocks.en: The result agrees with controlled pretraining studies in which fertility or token count did not reliably predict downstream performance [ 1 , 43 ] , and with transfer experiments in which extending the vocabulary to shorten target-language text was not needed [ 50 ] . It does not contradict the finding that compression tracks performance when everything except the tokenizer is held fixed [ 13 ] . Our measurements also do not support explaining Llama-family results by over-fragmentation [ 41 ] : on the same text, the Llama 3 tokenizer split words into fewer pieces than the Qwen and Mistral tokenizers.
blocks.zh: 其结果与有控制的预培训研究相一致,在这种研究中,生育率或象征性的计数并不可靠地预测下游的性能[1,43],与转移实验,在这种实验中,不需要扩大词汇以缩短目标语言文本[50]。 并不与除标定器外的一切物被固定 [13] 时的压缩轨道性能的结论相矛盾. 我们的测量也并不支持用过度分解来解释Llama-family结果[41]:在同一文本中,Llama 3的标致器将单词分成比Quen和Mistral标致器少的片段.

blocks.en: One mechanism deserves attention in future work. A large vocabulary lowers fertility but costs embedding parameters. Gemma-2-2B devotes 22.6% of its parameters to the embeddings of its 256k vocabulary and has the fewest non-embedding parameters of the three models (2.02B against 2.77–2.82B), so in our models lower fertility and lower non-embedding capacity come together, and the data cannot separate them.
blocks.zh: 一个机制值得在今后的工作中予以关注。 一个大的词汇降低了生育率,但成本嵌入参数。 Gemma-2-2B将其参数的22.6%用于其256k词汇的嵌入,并且拥有三种模型中最少的(2.02B对2.77–2.82B)非嵌入参数,因此在我们模型中,低生育率和低非嵌入能力相聚,数据无法将它们分开.

blocks.en: 6.3 Interpreting Gemma-2-2B
blocks.zh: 6.3 口译Gemma-2-2B

blocks.en: Gemma-2-2B is not an adaptation failure. Its chrF++ gain under the Alpaca prompt (+18.89) is the largest of the three small models, and its BPB falls by the same proportion as the others’ (to 0.349 of its zero-shot value). It starts lowest and ends lowest. Several differences could contribute, and our design cannot separate them: the fewest non-embedding parameters and pretraining tokens of the three models (Table 2 ); pretraining data that are primarily English [ 12 ] ; attention and final-logit soft-capping; Unsloth compilation disabled; a recipe tuned for none of the models; and a late rise in validation loss to 1.14–1.15 times its best earlier value. Its zero-shot behaviour, with the most English-like output across the two prompts and the lowest zero-shot chrF++ of the three small models, fits less pretraining exposure to Romanized Nepali, but exposure was not measured.
blocks.zh: Gemma-2-2B不是适应失败. 它的chrF++在阿尔帕卡速率(+18.89)下的增益是三个小模型中最大的,其BPB的下降比例与其它模型的下降比例相同(其零射值的0.349). 它从最低开始,从最低结束。 我们的设计不能将它们区分开来:三种模型中最少的非嵌入参数和预训符号(表2);主要是英语的预训数据[12];注意力和最终记录软刻;Unsloth编译被禁用;没有一种模型的配方;验证损失延迟上升到1.14-1.15倍,是其早期最佳价值的1.14-1.15倍。 其零镜头行为,在两个音符间输出最英式,在三个小模型中为最小的零镜头chrF++,符合较少训练前接触罗马化的尼泊尔语,但没有测量暴露.

blocks.en: 6.4 Zero-Shot Baselines and Gains
blocks.zh: 6.4 零热基线和收益

blocks.en: On this task, zero-shot baselines measure language choice and prompt-following as much as ability. Depending on the model and prompt, the base models answered in English, copied the prompt, looped or returned nothing. Gains over these baselines therefore mix a switch of output language with task learning, and the order of models by gain changed with the prompt and with the metric (Table 8 ). Rimal and Rimal [ 41 ] read such gains as evidence that models with weaker zero-shot performance have more representational plasticity. Our data do not support ranking models by gains when the base models mostly answer in another language: the model with the largest chrF++ gain under one prompt had the smallest under the other. The proportional fall in BPB was nearly constant across the four models and both prompts (64–66%), which suggests that likelihood is a steadier summary of how much a model changes with adaptation, within the limits discussed above. The concentration of zero-shot failures on type B prompts is consistent with base models having difficulty reading Romanized Nepali instructions.
blocks.zh: 在这个任务上,零射线基线测量语言选择和迅速跟随的能力等. 根据模型和即时性,基础模型以英语回答,复制即时性,循环或返回无. 因此,这些基线的收益将输出语言的切换与任务学习相结合,而模型的顺序随增益而随即和度量而变化(表8)。 Rimal和Rimal[41]将这种增益读作零射性能较弱的模型具有更多的代表性可塑性的证据. 我们的数据并不支持通过收益来进行排名的模型,因为基础模型大多用另一种语言回答:一个速率下ChrF++收益最大的模型在另一个速率下最小. BPB的比例下降在四种模式和两种模式中都几乎保持不变(64-66%),这表明,在上文讨论的限度内,一个模式在适应方面的变化有多大,这种可能性是比较稳定的总结。 零射门故障集中在B型提示上与阅读罗马化尼泊尔语指令有困难的基础模型一致.

blocks.en: 6.5 The Within-Family Comparison
blocks.zh: 6.5 家庭内部比较

blocks.en: With the tokenizer held fixed, the larger Llama model had clearly higher reference likelihood before and after fine-tuning, but after fine-tuning its outputs were only slightly closer to the references: by 0.68 chrF++ and 0.58 BLEU points, gains that hold across test items but, for chrF++, not across seeds. The comparison thus repeats, within one family and without any difference in segmentation, the pattern seen across families: a likelihood advantage that carries over to generation only in part. It cannot isolate the effect of parameter count, because Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.2-3B differ in model generation, data and distillation as well as size; Llama-3.2-3B was trained in part on the larger models’ output distributions [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 随着标注器的固定,较大的Llama模型在微调前后的参考可能性明显较高,但微调后其输出值仅略接近参考值:以0.68 chrF++和0.58 BLEU点表示,增益在测试项目之间保持,但对于chrF++来说,不跨种子. 因此,在一个家庭内部,这种比较重复了在划分上没有任何区别的家庭中所看到的格局:一种可能性优势只是部分地延续到一代人身上。 它不能孤立参数计数的效果,因为Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.2-3B在模型生成,数据和蒸馏以及大小上都不同;Llama-3.2-3B部分接受了大型模型输出分布[30]的培训.

blocks.en: 6.6 Implications
blocks.zh: 6.6 影响

blocks.en: Four practical points follow for adapting models to romanized varieties such as Romanized Nepali. First, tokenizer fertility should not be used on its own to choose among pretrained models; within the narrow range of modern tokenizers, other differences dominated. Second, the romanization convention is a design variable. In our measurements, lowercasing changed fertility by 13–14% and dropping the final inherent vowel by a further 3–4%, and the convention decides which distinctions of the script a model can recover, so benchmarks should report it. Third, adapted models should be evaluated with a byte-normalized likelihood together with generation metrics and an output audit, because the two kinds of measure separate models differently. Fourth, comparisons need several seeds and paired tests: chrF++ differences of 1.5–1.6 points were resolved by paired item-level tests but not across three seeds, and neither kind of interval alone captures both sources of variation.
blocks.zh: 采用罗马化的尼泊尔语等罗马化的品种, 首先,不应单独使用象征性的生育力在预先训练过的模型中进行选择;在现代象征性的狭义范围内,其他差异占主导地位。 第二,罗马化公约是一个设计变量. 在我们的测量中,将生育率降低13-14 % , 并将最终的固有元音再降低3-4 % , 而惯例决定了一个模型可以恢复的脚本区别,因此基准应该报告。 第三,应当以字节正常化的可能性与生成度量和产出审计一起评价经过调整的模型,因为这两种计量方法不同。 第四,比较需要几种种子和配对测试:chrF++1.5–1.6分的差异通过配对的项级测试得以解决,但不能跨越三种种子,而且这两种间隔都无法单独捕捉两种变异源.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Data. All results come from one instruction dataset of 10,500 examples, derived from a Nepali translation of the Stanford Alpaca data whose dataset card documents neither its provenance nor a licence. Romanized text was produced by deterministic, lowercased ITRANS transliteration. This scheme keeps word-final inherent vowels, merges 11 groups of letters and gives every word one spelling, so the benchmark does not test robustness to the spelling variation of naturally typed Romanized Nepali, to mixed scripts or to code-switching. Type A instructions were machine-translated back into English from a Nepali translation of English originals, which sometimes changes their meaning, and the two types differ in how the instruction was produced as well as in its language. Some training examples (1.4–2.0%) were truncated at 512 tokens, and a few outputs recur across splits.
blocks.zh: 数据。 所有结果都来自一个由10,500个实例组成的指令数据集,该数据集来源于斯坦福阿尔帕卡数据尼泊尔语译本,其数据集卡文件既没有其来源,也没有许可证. 罗马化文本由定型,小写ITRANS转写生成. 这个方案保留了单词最终的固有元音,将11组字母合并,并给每个单词一个拼写,因此基准没有测试自然输入的罗马化尼泊尔语的拼写变体,混合脚本或代码切换的稳健性. 类型 一项指令是从尼泊尔文英文原文译本中被机器翻译为英文的,有时会改变其含义,两种类型的指令在制作方式及其语言上有所不同。 一些培训实例(1.4-2.0%)被缩短为512个符号,少数产出在分裂中重复出现。

blocks.en: Models and recipe. Three base-model families were trained with one shared recipe that was not tuned per model. The models differ in tokenizer, architecture, non-embedding parameter count, pretraining data and distillation at once, so no difference between them can be attributed to any single factor, including the tokenizer. Unsloth left different modules unquantized in different models.
blocks.zh: 模型和食谱。 三个基本模式家庭接受了培训,有一个共同的食谱,不按模式调整。 模型在表示器,架构,非嵌入参数计数,预先训练数据和一次蒸馏方面有所不同,因此它们之间的任何区别都不能归结于任何单个因子,包括表示器. Unsloth在不同的模型中留下了不同的模块未量化.

blocks.en: Evaluation. All measures are automatic and single-reference. BLEU, chrF++ and ROUGE reward overlap with one reference; BERTScore relies on a multilingual encoder that has not been validated for Romanized Nepali; and bits per byte measures how probable the reference is, not how good a generated response is. The output audit uses surface heuristics, and its English-stopword list was screened against the test references. Zero-shot results depend on two prompt formats and our decoding settings.
blocks.zh: 评价。 所有措施都是自动和单一参照的。 BLEU、chrF++和ROUGE的奖励与一个参考重叠;BERTScore依赖于一个没有为罗马化的尼泊尔语验证过的多语种编码器;以及每个字节衡量参考的概率,而不是生成的响应有多好。 产出审计采用表面heuristics,其英文停词列表根据测试参考文献进行了筛选. 零镜头结果取决于两种快速格式和我们的解码设置.

blocks.en: Statistics. Three seeds give only a rough estimate of training variability. The paired item-level intervals condition on the trained seeds and the seed-level intervals on the test set; neither captures both sources of variation at once. BERTScore could not be recomputed from the saved outputs, so its values are those of the evaluation scripts. The divergence criterion was set post hoc, and the selected checkpoint steps were not retained.
blocks.zh: 统计。 三种种子只能粗略估计训练的可变性. 被训练种子的配对项目水平间隔条件和测试组的种子水平间隔条件;两者均不同时捕捉两种变异源. BERTScore无法从节省的产出中重新计算,因此其价值是评价脚本的价值。 差异标准是事后确定的,选定的检查站步骤没有保留。

blocks.en: Fertility analysis. The public-sample analysis used tokenizer files rebuilt from public sources, which reproduce the Hugging Face token counts exactly on the benchmark references, and a simple heuristic for dropping the final inherent vowel. Its sentences have shorter words than the benchmark responses.
blocks.zh: 生育率分析。 公共-样本分析使用了从公共来源重建的标语化文件,这些文件复制了Hugging Face符号精确地计算在基准参考文献上,还使用了一种简单的Heuristic来降低最终固有元音. 它的句子比基准响应的词短.

blocks.en: Within-family comparison. Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.2-3B differ in model generation, training data and distillation as well as size. The comparison does not measure an effect of parameter count.
blocks.zh: 家庭内部比较. Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.2-3B在模型生成、培训数据和蒸馏以及尺寸方面各不相同。 比较不测量参数计数的效果.

blocks.en: Software. Package versions differed across runs. One re-evaluation in a second environment reproduced its results exactly, but it covers one adapter.
