blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We asked how small open language models adapt to Romanized Nepali and whether common shortcuts identify the best one. All three 2–3B families adapted substantially under a shared QLoRA recipe, and their results varied across seeds by about as much as across test samples (RQ1). The shortcuts did not hold. The tokenizer that fragmented Romanized Nepali least belonged to the lowest-scoring model (RQ2). The model that assigned the highest likelihood to the references did not generate text closer to them than its nearest competitor, and within the Llama family, where tokenization was identical, the larger model’s likelihood advantage carried over to generation only in part (RQ3). Without adaptation the base models mostly answered in English, and which model gained most from fine-tuning depended on the zero-shot prompt (RQ4). For low-resource and romanized varieties, where a single proxy is tempting, these results argue for evaluating adapted models with several kinds of measure and explicit uncertainty. These conclusions hold for the transliterated benchmark on which they were obtained.
blocks.zh: 我们问道,小型开放语言模型如何适应罗马化的尼泊尔语,常见的捷径是否确定最好的捷径。 所有3个2-3B家庭都根据共同的QLORA食谱进行了大幅调整,其结果因种子而异,几乎与测试样本(RQ1)相同。 捷径没有被挡住。 支离破碎的罗马化尼泊尔语最少的标语符号属于得分最低的模型(RQ2). 给参考文献提供最大可能性的模型没有产生比最近的竞争者更接近其文本的文本,在Llama家族中,标识完全相同,更大的模型的可能性优势只是部分地延续到生成(RQ3)。 没有适应,基础模型大多用英语回答,而哪一种模型从微调中获得最多的取决于零射速率(RQ4). 对于资源低和罗马化的品种,如果有一个单一的代用物具有诱惑力,这些结果就要求评价经过调整的模型,并有几种计量和明确的不确定性。 这些结论是获得这些结论的转写基准。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: We used a publicly available instruction dataset whose card states no licence. It is a Nepali translation of the Stanford Alpaca data (Section 3.1 ), whose CC BY-NC 4.0 licence restricts it to non-commercial use. We collected no personal data and recruited no participants. The sentences used in the fertility analysis come from the Mozilla Common Voice text corpus, released under CC0, and a Nepali translation of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights distributed with NLTK. Models were used under their licences: the Llama 3.2 and Llama 3.1 Community Licenses, the Gemma Terms of Use and the Qwen Research License, which restricts Qwen2.5-3B to research use. Fine-tuned models can produce incorrect or biased text, and even the fine-tuned models occasionally copied prompts, looped or switched to English, so they should not be used in high-stakes settings without human review. The transliteration scheme determines which spellings the models learn and does not reflect how all writers of Romanized Nepali spell.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了公开的指令数据集,其卡片上写着没有许可证. 这是斯坦福阿尔帕卡数据(第3.1节)的尼泊尔语译本,其CC BY-NC 4.0许可证将其限制于非商业用途. 我们没有收集个人资料,也没有招募参与者。 生育力分析中使用的句子来自CC0下发布的Mozilla共同语音文字集,以及尼泊尔语译文《世界人权宣言》,与尼泊尔国家LTK一起分发。 其许可证下使用模型:Llama 3.2和Llama 3.1社区许可证、Gemma使用条件和Quen研究许可证,这些许可证将Quen2.5-3B限制在研究使用。 微调模型可以产生不正确或偏颇的文字,甚至微调模型偶尔会复制提示,循环或切换到英语,所以未经人类审查,它们不应该用于高考环境. 转写方案决定了模式学习的拼写方式,并不反映所有罗马化尼泊尔语拼音的写法.

blocks.en: Conventions. Devanagari was converted to ITRANS with indic_transliteration 2.3.82 [ 18 ] (R1), then lowercased (R2). R3 removes the final a from R2 words whose Devanagari form ends in a consonant letter without a virama and has at least two aksharas; words ending in a candrabindu, anusvara or visarga are unchanged. Trailing punctuation is split off before transliteration, so the danda becomes “|”. Under R2, the 11 groups in Table 13 merge; lowercasing also merges the anusvara with a virama-marked (both m ) and the visarga with a virama-marked (both h ), and it merges the nukta letters , , and with their plain forms, although these are rare in Nepali.

blocks.en: Tokenizers. Hugging Face model files could not be retrieved in the analysis environment, so tokenizers were rebuilt from public files with each model’s published pre-tokenization: the Llama 3 BPE ranks from Meta’s llama-models repository with the Llama 3 split pattern, the Qwen BPE ranks (151,643 tokens) distributed with the dashscope 2.0.4 package with Qwen’s pattern (single digits), the Gemma SentencePiece model from the gemma_pytorch repository, and the Mistral v0.1 SentencePiece model from mistral-common 1.13.1. Word-level counts encode each word with a leading space, or with SentencePiece’s own prefix for Mistral. As a check, these tokenizers reproduce the Hugging Face token counts of the Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b and Mistral-7B-v0.1 tokenizers exactly on all 1,000 benchmark references. Fertility is the mean over sentences of tokens per word, with 1,000 bootstrap resamples over sentences (seed 0); the order of tokenizers was checked over 2,000 paired resamples (seed 1). The script and its full output, including intervals for all conventions and type-level fertility, are in the code repository.
blocks.zh: 托基纳 Hugging Face模型文件无法在分析环境中检索,因此从公共文件中重建了标注器,每个模型的发布预tokenization:Llama 3 BPE从Meta的lama模型存储器中排出,Llama 3的分割图案,Quen BPE排出(151,643个令牌),用Quen的图案(单位数)的破折镜2.0.4包分配,Gemma PriedPiece模型从gemma_pytorch存储器中排出,Mistral v0.1 Piece模型从mstral-common 1.13.1中排出. Word-level 计算每个词的编码, 并带有一个领先的空间, 或带有 PericePiece 自己的 Mistral 前缀 。 作为检查,这些标致器复制了所有1000个基准参考文献中准确的Hugging Face标致器计数器Llama-3.2-3B,Quen2.5-3B,gemma-2-2b和Mistral-7B-v0.1. 生育力是每个字的符号的句子上的平均值,有1000个靴子的复标值在句子上(种子0);对2 000多对复标的顺序进行了检查(种子1)。 脚本及其全部产出,包括所有公约的间隔和类型水平的生育力,都在代码库中。
